items.title: ELITE: E3 Ligase Inference for Tissue specific Elimination: A LLM Based E3 Ligase Prediction System for Precise Targeted Protein Degradation
items.abstract_or_text: Targeted protein degradation (TPD) has transformed modern drug discovery by harnessing the ubiquitin-proteasome system to eliminate disease-driving proteins previously deemed undruggable. However, current approaches predominantly rely on a narrow set of ubiquitously expressed E3 ligases, such as Cereblon (CRBN) and Von Hippel-Lindau (VHL), which limits tissue specificity, increases systemic toxicity, and fosters resistance. Here, we present an AI-driven framework for the rational identification of tissue-specific E3 ligases suitable for precision-targeted degradation. Our model leverages an BERT-based protein language architecture trained on billions of sequences to generate contextual embeddings that capture structural and functional motifs relevant for E3-substrate compatibility. By integrating these embeddings with tissue-resolved protein-protein interaction data, the framework predicts ligase-target interactions that are both biologically plausible and context-restricted. This enables the prioritization of ligases capable of driving selective degradation of pathogenic proteins within disease-relevant tissues. The proposed approach offers a scalable path to expand the E3 ligase repertoire and advance TPD toward true precision medicine. The AI architecture used in this study builds upon a well-established, state-of-the-art protein language modeling framework rather than introducing a fundamentally new model design. The principal contribution instead lies in the deliberate engineering of a task-specific dataset that integrates large-scale protein sequence embeddings with tissue-resolved expression and interaction information tailored to targeted protein degradation. By curating and harmonizing these heterogeneous data modalities for the explicit purpose of identifying tissue-selective E3 ligases, we enable a generalizable foundation model to be effectively adapted to a previously unexplored application context. This data-centric advance underpins the framework's ability to generate biologically meaningful, context-aware predictions and represents a central contribution of the present work.
items.summary_zh: ELITE 将蛋白质语言模型嵌入与组织分辨的表达和 PPI 数据整合，以优先筛选组织特异性 E3 ligase。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本的数据工程面向精确靶向蛋白降解中的组织选择性问题；摘要未报告独立实验验证或定量基准，因此预测仍应视为候选优先级。
items.abstract_zh: 靶向蛋白降解（TPD）通过利用泛素—蛋白酶体系统清除先前被认为不可成药的疾病驱动蛋白，已改变现代药物发现。然而，当前方法主要依赖少数广泛表达的 E3 ligase，例如 Cereblon（CRBN）和 Von Hippel-Lindau（VHL），这限制了组织特异性、增加了全身毒性并促进耐药。这里，我们提出一个 AI 驱动框架，用于理性识别适合精确靶向降解的组织特异性 E3 ligase。我们的模型利用在数十亿条序列上训练的基于 BERT 的蛋白质语言架构，生成可捕捉与 E3—底物兼容性相关的结构和功能基序的上下文嵌入。通过将这些嵌入与组织分辨的蛋白质—蛋白质相互作用数据整合，该框架预测在生物学上合理且受情境限制的 ligase—靶标相互作用。这使得能够优先筛选可在疾病相关组织内驱动病原蛋白选择性降解的 ligase。该方法为扩展 E3 ligase 谱系并推动 TPD 迈向真正的精准医学提供了可扩展路径。本研究使用的 AI 架构建立在成熟、最先进的蛋白质语言建模框架之上，而非引入根本性的新模型设计。其主要贡献在于审慎构建了一个任务特异性数据集：它整合大规模蛋白质序列嵌入，以及为靶向蛋白降解定制的组织分辨表达与相互作用信息。通过为明确识别组织选择性 E3 ligase 的目的整理并协调这些异质数据模态，我们使一个通用基础模型得以有效适配到此前未探索的应用情境。这一以数据为中心的进展支撑了该框架生成具有生物学意义、具情境感知的预测能力，并构成本研究的核心贡献。

items.abstract_zh: Raven 0.2.0——为递归自我改进（RSI）构建的“工具链的工具链”。一套工具链不可能在所有事情上都做到最好。Raven将自己的专用工具链（研究、编码、设计、运维）与您已经使用的代理（Claude Code、Codex等）组合成一个团队。它的设计目标不仅是技能层面的RSI：整个工具链都可以由AI重写，包括提示、策略、策略代码和运行手册。开源，采用Apache-2.0许可。

items.title: MoTIF-X: A Multimodal Tokenized Framework for Interpretable and Extensible Molecular Representation Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular representation learning is central to computer-aided drug discovery. Molecular graphs, SMILES strings, and 3D conformations provide complementary structural information, yet many multimodal approaches encode these views independently and align them only at a later stage, limiting fine-grained cross-modal interaction and substructure-level interpretability. To address these limitations, we introduce MoTIF-X, a motif-centered framework that uses graph-grounded chemical motifs as shared anchors for multimodal integration and interpretation. Its first pretraining stage learns motif representations through hierarchical contrastive learning across atomic, motif, and molecular scales. The second stage contextualizes these representations with SMILES and torsion-angle tokens through multimodal masked token modeling. After pretraining on drug-like molecules with multiple conformers, MoTIF-X achieved the lowest mean absolute error on all nine OpenADMET ExpansionRx endpoints and the best overall performance among the evaluated methods. Significance analyses supported its advantage in the vast majority of endpoint-baseline comparisons after multiple-testing correction. Ablation studies supported the complementary contributions of motif-token contextualization, multimodal integration, and two-stage pretraining. Beyond molecular properties, the framework extended to drug-target interaction prediction, achieving the best average classification performance across the evaluated benchmarks and generalizing to an external drug-cold-start dataset without additional fine-tuning. Its motif-centered design also enabled substructure-level interpretation: higher motif attribution scores were associated with larger experimentally measured activity shifts. Together, these findings support MoTIF-X as a transferable and interpretable framework for molecular modeling.
items.summary_zh: MoTIF-X以图结构化学基元为共同锚点，联合分子图、SMILES和3D构象进行多模态分子表征学习，并用于分子性质预测和药物-靶点相互作用预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时覆盖九个OpenADMET ExpansionRx端点、药物-靶点相互作用和外部冷启动数据集，并以消融和实验活性变化支持基元级解释；但性能优势仍取决于所用基准和预训练分布。
items.abstract_zh: 分子表征学习是计算机辅助药物发现的核心。分子图、SMILES字符串和3D构象提供互补的结构信息，但许多多模态方法分别编码这些视图，仅在较晚阶段进行对齐，从而限制了细粒度的跨模态交互和亚结构级可解释性。为解决这些局限，我们提出MoTIF-X，这是一种以基元为中心的框架，使用以图为基础的化学基元作为多模态整合与解释的共享锚点。其第一阶段预训练通过在原子、基元和分子尺度之间进行分层对比学习来学习基元表征。第二阶段通过多模态掩码标记建模，利用SMILES和扭转角标记对这些表征进行上下文化。在含有多个构象的类药分子上预训练后，MoTIF-X在全部九个OpenADMET ExpansionRx端点上取得最低的平均绝对误差，并在所评估方法中获得最佳总体性能。多重检验校正后的显著性分析支持其在绝大多数端点-基线比较中的优势。消融研究支持基元标记上下文化、多模态整合和两阶段预训练的互补贡献。除分子性质外，该框架还扩展到药物-靶点相互作用预测，在所评估基准上取得最佳平均分类性能，并在无需额外微调的情况下泛化到外部药物冷启动数据集。其以基元为中心的设计还实现了亚结构级解释：更高的基元归因分数与实验测得的更大活性变化相关。总体而言，这些结果支持MoTIF-X作为一种可迁移且可解释的分子建模框架。
items.author_line: Linqing Mo, Jiayu Zhou, Bin Chen

items.title: Benchmarking graph-based models for in-silico toxicity prediction in drug discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Drug discovery is a costly and high-risk process, where toxicity-related failures remain a major cause of attrition in both preclinical and clinical stages. As a result, accurate early prediction of chemical toxicity is essential to reduce downstream costs and improve compound prioritization. In this context, graph deep learning (GDL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for toxicity prediction, leveraging molecular graph representations to learn directly from chemical structure with improved expressivity over traditional approaches. Despite the growing number of proposed models, current literature-based comparisons are often difficult to interpret due to inconsistencies in datasets, preprocessing pipelines, and evaluation protocols. To address this limitation, we introduce a unified and standardized benchmarking framework for GDL-based toxicity prediction. We systematically evaluate more than 20 representative approaches under consistent experimental conditions and across multiple datasets and partitioning strategies, enabling a fair and reproducible comparison of model performance. In addition, we complement this empirical study with a structured literature analysis to contextualize existing methodological trends and performance claims. Our results provide a clearer and more reliable assessment of the current state of the field, highlighting both the strengths and limitations of existing graph-based approaches. To support transparency and reproducibility, we release our benchmarking framework as open-source software https://gitlab.citius.gal/noel.suarez/benchtox, allowing the community to evaluate and compare models under consistent conditions.
items.summary_zh: 研究在统一数据、预处理和评估条件下，系统比较20多种图深度学习毒性预测方法，并跨多个数据集和划分策略分析其性能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为药物毒性预测提供可复现的公平比较框架，并公开BenchTox软件；但基准结果仍受数据集代表性、划分方案和体外到体内外推限制影响。
items.abstract_zh: 药物发现成本高且风险大，毒性相关失败仍是临床前和临床阶段项目流失的主要原因。因此，准确地早期预测化学毒性对于降低后续成本和改进化合物优先级排序至关重要。在这一背景下，图深度学习（GDL）已成为毒性预测的重要范式，它利用分子图表示直接从化学结构中学习，相比传统方法具有更强的表达能力。尽管提出的模型越来越多，但由于数据集、预处理流程和评估方案不一致，基于文献的比较往往难以解释。为解决这一限制，我们建立了一个统一、标准化的GDL毒性预测基准框架。在一致的实验条件下，并跨多个数据集和划分策略，我们系统评估了20多种具有代表性的方法，从而实现公平且可复现的模型性能比较。此外，我们还通过结构化文献分析对实证研究进行补充，以说明现有方法趋势和性能声明的背景。我们的结果更清晰、更可靠地评估了该领域当前状态，揭示了现有图模型方法的优势和局限。为支持透明性和可复现性，我们发布了开源基准框架https://gitlab.citius.gal/noel.suarez/benchtox，使研究群体能够在一致条件下评估和比较模型。
items.author_line: Noel Suarez-Barro, Manuel Lama, Juan C. Vidal

items.title: Biological rationales from language models enable leakage-resistant forecasts of target-indication success
items.abstract_or_text: Identifying which target-indication (T-I) hypotheses can translate into clinical success remains a central challenge in drug discovery. We present PRIORITI (Prospective Rationale-Informed Outcome Reasoning for Integrated Target-indication Intelligence), a leakage-resistant framework that separates upstream biological evidence synthesis from outcome prediction. Given only a target gene and disease indication, a domain-instructed large language model (LLM) synthesizes drug-agnostic human genetics across prespecified channels. These evidence were embedded and combined with static entity context derived from gene summaries and disease definitions. The resulting representation is used to fit a supervised model trained on 6,784 temporally curated historical T-I outcomes, which is one of the largest cohorts assembled for this task. On a held-out historical test set of 1,696 T-I pairs, PRIORITI achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.883 and an expected calibration error (ECE) of 0.023, outperforming both a static target and indication context baseline and a human-curated genetic-evidence reference. On a strictly post-cutoff out-of-time benchmark of 765 T-I pairs, the largest such evaluation cohort reported to date, performance remained robust, with ROC-AUC 0.817, PR-AUC 0.357 and ECE 0.044, exceeding static target and indication context baseline and direct zero-shot LLM forecasting. A label-blinded LLM-based explainer further converted locked predictions into auditable prioritization rationales. Together, PRIORITI provides a calibrated, biology-first probability together with decision-oriented rationales for T-I prioritization before downstream translational investment.
items.summary_zh: PRIORITI 以 LLM 整合不依赖具体药物的人类遗传学证据，并在时间外 target-indication 预测中保持校准性能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本以 6,784 个时间整理的历史 T-I 结局训练，并在 765 个严格截止日期后的配对上评估；结果支持其作为转化投入前的优先级工具，但不构成靶点临床成功的因果或临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 识别哪些靶点—适应症（T-I）假设能够转化为临床成功，仍是药物发现中的核心挑战。我们提出 PRIORITI（Prospective Rationale-Informed Outcome Reasoning for Integrated Target-indication Intelligence），这是一个抗信息泄漏框架，将上游生物学证据综合与结局预测分离。仅给定一个靶基因和疾病适应症，经过领域指令训练的大语言模型（LLM）便可跨预先指定的通道综合不依赖具体药物的人类遗传学证据。这些证据被嵌入，并与来自基因摘要和疾病定义的静态实体上下文相结合。由此得到的表征用于拟合一个监督模型，该模型在 6,784 个经过时间整理的历史 T-I 结局上训练，是为该任务构建的最大队列之一。在包含 1,696 个 T-I 配对的留出历史测试集上，PRIORITI 达到 0.883 的 ROC-AUC 和 0.023 的期望校准误差（ECE），优于静态靶点和适应症上下文基线，以及人工整理的遗传证据参考。在包含 765 个 T-I 配对的严格截止日期后时间外基准上——这是迄今报告的此类评估中最大的队列——其性能仍然稳健，ROC-AUC 为 0.817、PR-AUC 为 0.357、ECE 为 0.044，超过静态靶点和适应症上下文基线以及直接零样本 LLM 预测。一个标签盲化的基于 LLM 的解释器进一步将锁定的预测转化为可审计的优先级理由。总体而言，PRIORITI 在下游转化投入之前，为 T-I 优先级排序提供了经校准的、以生物学为先的概率及面向决策的理由。
items.author_line: Zhang, W., Xu, J., Zhang, Z., Liu, M., Sun, R., Al-lazikani, B., Shen, X., Kopetz, S., Wu, L., Zhao, B., Wu, C.

items.title: An agentic AI environment to support biomedical research in collaborative academic environments
items.abstract_or_text: Agentic artificial intelligence (AAI) is increasingly used by biomedical scientists, where it has substantially lowered the difficulty of integrating computational, statistical and data-science approaches into day-to-day research activities, assisting with project design, analysis and manuscript preparation. Significant barriers remain, however, which are unlikely to be removed solely by releasing more capable AI models. Meaningful use still demands a technical fluency that many biomedical researchers lack: a PI and their lab members must learn how to use the AAI system, establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) for managing, sharing and curating data, and enforce rules that address data privacy and security. Existing commercial AAI systems, which were designed primarily for software engineering purposes, need to be significantly re-purposed for biomedical-related data science. We present Murmurent, shared software that sits beneath the agentic AI and provides the skills, procedures and protections to address the concerns above, removing the need for a lab to develop them independently. This includes (1) infrastructure to support projects and so-called choreographies} involving multiple group members; (2) a set of specialized agents each dedicated to typical biomedical data science tasks including software and statistical development, data visualization, literature search, equity, diversity, inclusion, and decolonization (EDID) review, and others; (3) a tiered memory which can retain important research decisions, intermediate, derived outputs and sensitive data, and which can exploit this information to automatically build better contexts in AAI sessions; (4) traceability records which are used by the AAI session to better plan and execute data analyses and software builds by, for example, helping to avoid repeating decisions that lead to dead-ends; (5) enforcement of SOPs for data maintenance and data governance across all lab members; and (6) multi-user capacity to allow groups to interact and collaborate. We use the system to identify putative inhibitors of Peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans Isomerase NIMA-interacting 1 (Pin1), a protein with a shallow catalytic site making it difficult to target. We describe the construction of several approaches to identify Pin1 inhibitors and the results they yield. Murmurent is open source.
items.summary_zh: 开源 Murmurent 为协作型生物医学实验室提供智能体、分层记忆、可追溯性和数据治理，并用于探索 Pin1 抑制剂。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本关注可复现协作、隐私和 SOP 执行等实验室落地条件；Pin1 结果为候选探索，摘要未给出其抑制剂的实验效力验证。
items.abstract_zh: 智能体人工智能（AAI）正日益被生物医学科学家使用，它已大幅降低了将计算、统计和数据科学方法整合到日常研究活动中的难度，并辅助项目设计、分析和论文准备。然而，仍存在重大障碍，而且仅通过发布能力更强的 AI 模型不太可能消除这些障碍。有意义的使用仍要求许多生物医学研究人员所缺乏的技术熟练度：PI 及其实验室成员必须学习如何使用 AAI 系统，建立用于管理、共享和整理数据的标准操作程序（SOPs），并执行处理数据隐私和安全的规则。现有商业 AAI 系统主要为软件工程目的而设计，需要针对生物医学相关数据科学进行重大改造。我们提出 Murmurent，这是一种位于智能体 AI 之下的共享软件，提供解决上述问题所需的技能、程序和保护措施，使实验室无需独立开发这些内容。这包括：（1）支持项目及涉及多个组成员的所谓 choreographies 的基础设施；（2）一组专用智能体，每个智能体均专注于典型生物医学数据科学任务，包括软件和统计开发、数据可视化、文献检索、平等、多样性、包容性与去殖民化（EDID）审查等；（3）一种分层记忆，可保留重要研究决策、中间和衍生输出以及敏感数据，并可利用这些信息在 AAI 会话中自动构建更好的上下文；（4）可追溯性记录，AAI 会话利用其更好地规划和执行数据分析和软件构建，例如帮助避免重复导致死胡同的决策；（5）在全体实验室成员中执行数据维护和数据治理的 SOPs；以及（6）允许群组互动和协作的多用户能力。我们使用该系统识别 Peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans Isomerase NIMA-interacting 1（Pin1）的推定抑制剂；该蛋白具有浅催化位点，因而难以靶向。我们描述了构建若干识别 Pin1 抑制剂的方法及其产生的结果。Murmurent 是开源的。

items.title: GenLimitLib: A Formal Library for Language Generation in the Limit and AI-Assisted Mathematical Research
items.abstract_or_text: We present GenLimitLib, a source-aligned Lean 4 library for language generation in the limit. Introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan at NeurIPS 2024, language generation in the limit studies a theoretical question motivated by LLMs: how to generate valid new strings from observed examples. This young and rapidly evolving field offers a natural testbed for studying large-scale formalization. GenLimitLib contains formal developments for 30 papers. It extracts shared definitions and reusable proof components while preserving paper-specific assumptions and statements, and records relationships across papers. In this way, GenLimitLib provides a concrete and structured view of the literature. We show through mathematical case studies and LLM experiments how our library can support both human mathematical research and AI-assisted research. Our Library: https://github.com/pengzhang91/generation-in-the-limit-lib.
items.summary_zh: GenLimitLib 是与来源对齐的 Lean 4 形式化库，收录“language generation in the limit”领域 30 篇论文的定义、可复用证明组件和论文间关系，并用数学案例和 LLM 实验展示其研究辅助价值。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把新兴理论文献系统地转成可检查、可复用的 Lean 资源，为证明助手和 AI 辅助数学研究提供了明确的形式化资产。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 GenLimitLib，一个与来源对齐的 Lean 4 语言极限生成形式化库。由 Kleinberg 和 Mullainathan 在 NeurIPS 2024 引入的 language generation in the limit 研究一个受 LLM 启发的理论问题：如何从观察到的示例中生成有效的新字符串。这一年轻且快速发展的领域为大规模形式化提供了自然试验场。GenLimitLib 包含 30 篇论文的形式化发展成果。它提取共享定义和可复用证明组件，同时保留各论文特有的假设和陈述，并记录论文之间的关系。通过数学案例研究和 LLM 实验，我们展示了该库如何支持人类数学研究和 AI 辅助研究。我们的库：https://github.com/pengzhang91/generation-in-the-limit-lib。

items.title: Why Deterministic PRM Guidance Underperforms in Discrete Diffusion Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) expose a denoised solution at every step, which makes process reward model (PRM) guidance look like a way to spend compute at test time. We show that once denoising, PRM scoring, and outcome reward model (ORM) scoring are charged in the same budget of forward passes, its deterministic form loses to a much simpler baseline. Our PRMs score intermediate denoising states and are trained on the correctness of the final answer. On Dream-v0-Instruct-7B with 8 candidates per GSM8K problem, keeping the candidate with the highest PRM score at every scoring step reaches 65.18%, while independent sampling plus an ORM reranker trained for the task reaches 75.13%. The gap grows to 12.69 percentage points (pp) with 32 candidates, and is 9.85 pp on MATH and 12.16 pp on MBPP. We trace it to two separable failures. First, guidance prunes on a weak signal: on GSM8K, PRM ROC-AUC falls from 0.77 to 0.54 as the mask ratio rises, a decay that persists when states are relabeled with fresh rollouts, and pruning lowers the best accuracy reachable from the candidate pool from 81.05% for independent samples to 67.30%. Second, on GSM8K and MATH, the PRM is a poor final judge: a sequential Monte Carlo sampler at the same budget restores that ceiling to 77.89%, yet selecting with the PRM gives 65.48%, on par with deterministic guidance, while a PRM retrained on final states matches the ORM on identical candidates. MBPP separates the two: there the PRM reaches 65.47% when reranking finished programs, on par with the ORM, but 50.88% when it guides denoising. The results point to two targets for dLLM guidance: keep correct partial solutions alive through early denoising, and leave the final choice to a verifier trained on final states. We release the corpus of denoising states with outcome labels and evaluation toolkit for reproducible comparisons at matched compute.
items.summary_zh: 论文在统一前向计算预算下比较离散扩散语言模型中的 PRM 引导、独立采样和 ORM 重排，发现确定性 PRM 引导会因早期错误剪枝和终态判别弱而落后。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它不仅报告性能差异，还用 ROC-AUC、候选池上限和重训练对照拆分失败原因，为测试时验证器设计提供了可检验诊断。
items.abstract_zh: 离散扩散语言模型（dLLM）在每一步都暴露去噪后的解答，这使得过程奖励模型（PRM）引导看起来像是在测试时使用计算的一种方式。我们表明，当去噪、PRM 评分和结果奖励模型（ORM）评分都按相同的前向次数预算计费时，其确定性形式会输给一个简单得多的基线。我们的 PRM 对中间去噪状态进行评分，并根据最终答案的正确性进行训练。在 Dream-v0-Instruct-7B 上，对每个 GSM8K 问题生成 8 个候选，若在每个评分步骤保留 PRM 分数最高的候选，准确率为 65.18%；而独立采样加上针对该任务训练的 ORM 重排达到 75.13%。当候选数为 32 时，差距扩大到 12.69 个百分点（pp）；在 MATH 和 MBPP 上，差距分别为 9.85 和 12.16 个百分点。我们将其归因于两个可分离的失败。第一，引导在弱信号上进行剪枝：在 GSM8K 上，随着掩码比例上升，PRM ROC-AUC 从 0.77 降至 0.54；即便用新生成的轨迹重新标注状态，这种衰减仍然存在，而且剪枝会把候选池中可达到的最高准确率从独立采样的 81.05% 降至 67.30%。第二，在 GSM8K 和 MATH 上，PRM 是一个较差的最终评判器：同样预算下，序贯蒙特卡洛采样将这一上限恢复到 77.89%，但使用 PRM 选择后准确率为 65.48%，与确定性引导相当；而在相同候选上重新训练、针对最终状态的 PRM 可达到与 ORM 相当的效果。MBPP 将两者区分开来：在对完成的程序重排时，PRM 达到 65.47%，与 ORM 相当；但在引导去噪时只有 50.88%。这些结果指出，dLLM 引导需要解决两个目标：在早期去噪中保留正确的部分解答，并把最终选择留给针对最终状态训练的验证器。我们发布了带结果标签的去噪状态语料和评估工具包，以便在匹配计算预算下进行可复现实验。

items.title: Solver Agent: an Agentic AI Framework for Theoretical Physics Computations Applied to F-theory Uplifts of O3-planes and S-folds
items.abstract_or_text: We introduce Solver Agent, an AI framework based on large language models for calculations and proofs in mathematics and theoretical physics. The solution process is tracked through a persistent ledger that records assumptions, derivations, and computations. A central agent delegates tasks to specialized sub-agents, while independent agents verify both intermediate steps and the final result. This setup improves the traceability, reproducibility, and verification of computer-assisted calculations. Applying Solver Agent, we study global F-theory uplifts of Type IIB orientifolds and their S-fold generalizations. We establish sufficient conditions for Weierstrass models over projective threefolds with terminal Z_k quotient singularities (k\in\{2,3,4,6\}) to give Q-factorial projective elliptically fibered Calabi-Yau fourfolds with isolated Gorenstein terminal quotient singularities. These geometries realize O3-planes and S-folds, where local D3-brane probes of the latter yield four-dimensional N=3 superconformal field theories. Using stringy invariants, we derive fixed-point contributions to Hodge data and Euler characteristics, and show that these Euler corrections determine the localized D3-brane charges required for tadpole cancellation. We illustrate these results using toric hypersurface constructions, where a single three-dimensional polytope determines both the Type IIB Calabi-Yau threefold and the F-theory base; here, the orientifold double cover naturally forms a bisection of an alternative genus-one-fibered uplift with discrete Z_2 gauge symmetry. Finally, we provide methods for toric computations and four-form flux analysis in four-dimensional N=1 compactifications with non-abelian gauge sectors.
items.summary_zh: Solver Agent 用持久化账本记录假设、推导和计算，由中央智能体分派专门子任务，并让独立智能体验证中间步骤与最终结果；应用于 F-theory 中 O3-plane 和 S-fold 的 uplift 计算。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是候选中少数直接面向数学与理论物理计算、并把审计轨迹和独立校验纳入工作流的智能体框架；其结论仍应按摘要所述的充分条件和示例理解。
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍 Solver Agent，一种基于大型语言模型、用于数学和理论物理计算与证明的 AI 框架。解答过程通过持久化账本进行跟踪，账本记录假设、推导和计算。一个中央智能体将任务分派给专门子智能体，同时由独立智能体验证中间步骤和最终结果。这种设置提高了计算机辅助计算的可追踪性、可复现性和可验证性。我们将 Solver Agent 应用于研究 Type IIB 轨形的全局 F-theory uplift 及其 S-fold 推广。我们为带有终端 Z_k 商奇点（k∈{2,3,4,6}）的射影三维簇上的 Weierstrass 模型，建立其成为具有孤立 Gorenstein 终端商奇点的 Q-factorial 射影椭圆纤维化 Calabi-Yau 四维簇的充分条件。这些几何实现了 O3-plane 和 S-fold，其中后者的局部 D3-brane 探针产生四维 N=3 超共形场论。利用弦论不变量，我们推导 Hodge 数据和 Euler 示性数中的不动点贡献，并表明这些 Euler 修正确定了潮汐抵消所需的局域 D3-brane 电荷。我们用 toric 超曲面构造说明这些结果：单个三维多面体同时确定 Type IIB Calabi-Yau 三维簇和 F-theory 底空间；定向双覆盖自然形成另一种带离散 Z_2 规范对称性的亏格一纤维化 uplift 的二截面。最后，我们给出四维 N=1 紧化中带非阿贝尔规范扇区的 toric 计算和四形式通量分析方法。

items.title: Language-model-derived training data for polymer glass transition prediction: a controlled benchmark
items.abstract_or_text: Experimental glass transition temperatures (Tg) are known for only a few thousand polymers, and each new one costs a synthesis and a measurement. Large language models (LLMs) have read much of the polymer literature and answer questions about polymers for a fraction of a cent. We tested whether such answers can replace or supplement measurements for Tg prediction by two routes: asking Claude Sonnet 5 to write polymers together with their Tg, and asking it to assign a Tg to existing hypothetical polymers. Both datasets were used to train a chemical language model, which was compared on held-out measurements with the same model trained on a growing number of real measurements, alone or after a first stage on the synthetic data. Controls with shuffled Tg values and with the model’s own pseudo-labels separated the value of the LLM’s labels from that of merely seeing more structures. Models trained only on LLM data were about as accurate as the LLM itself and clearly worse than models trained on real data. The LLM data helped only when a few hundred measurements were available, and the benefit disappeared when the Tg values were shuffled. Many “generated” polymers were recalled copies of known polymers, and the LLM’s Tg values were coarse and biased low. LLM-produced data are thus an inexpensive supplement when measurements are scarce, not a substitute for them.
items.summary_zh: 该受控基准检验由Claude Sonnet 5生成的聚合物及玻璃化转变温度标签能否用于Tg预测，并与真实测量数据训练的模型进行比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 通过打乱标签和伪标签对照区分了结构数量效应与LLM标签价值，结论清楚地限定了合成数据只能在测量样本很少时作为补充；生成聚合物存在已知结构复现和Tg偏低偏粗的问题。
items.abstract_zh: 实验测得的玻璃化转变温度（Tg）仅对几千种聚合物已知，而每一种新的聚合物都需要合成和测量。大型语言模型（LLM）读过大量聚合物文献，并可以用不到一美分的成本回答关于聚合物的问题。我们通过两种方式测试这些回答能否替代或补充Tg测量：要求Claude Sonnet 5同时写出聚合物及其Tg，以及要求其为现有的假想聚合物指定Tg。我们利用这两套数据训练化学语言模型，并在留出的测量数据上进行比较；对照模型使用不断增加的真实测量数据训练，或先在合成数据上进行第一阶段训练再使用真实数据训练。通过打乱Tg值以及使用模型自身伪标签的对照实验，我们区分了LLM标签本身的价值与仅仅观察更多结构所带来的价值。仅使用LLM数据训练的模型，其准确性约等于LLM本身，明显低于使用真实数据训练的模型。只有在已有几百个测量值时，LLM数据才有所帮助；当Tg值被打乱后，这一收益消失。许多“生成”的聚合物是已知聚合物的回忆式复制，而LLM给出的Tg数值粗糙且存在偏低偏差。因此，在测量数据稀缺时，LLM生成的数据可以作为低成本补充，但不能替代测量。

items.title: Simultaneous CEA and CDH-17 Detection from Cancer Extracellular Vesicles Via Machine Learning Enabled Bio Silent Azide-Infrared Spectroscopy
items.abstract_or_text: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) provide a rich, minimally invasive source of cancer biomarkers, yet EV surface glycoproteins remain comparatively underexploited compared with EV internal cargo. Here, we report a bio silent, azide-based Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopic platform for simultaneous, label-minimal detection of two colorectal cancer (CRC) EV surface biomarkers, carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) and cadherin-17 (CDH-17), directly from intact vesicles. EVs from five CRC cell lines and a non-cancerous control line were first distinguished by their intrinsic biochemical fingerprints across the lipid, protein, carbohydrate, and nucleic acid spectral regions, achieving up to 97% classification accuracy by multivariate (PCA/SIMCA) and machine-learning (PLS-DA) analysis. Selective azide labeling of CEA and CDH-17 via biotinylated antibodies and streptavidin–azide generated a specific vibrational signal in the 2000–2300 cm⁻¹ bio-silent window without perturbing native EV spectra; peak authenticity was confirmed by Gaussian deconvolution, quantitative signal-to-noise analysis (SNR = 315 ± 99), and buffer/serum-artifact controls. Density-of-states overlap, cosine correlation, and constrained non-negative least-squares regression enabled simultaneous deconvolution and quantification of both biomarkers from mixed-antibody spectra, resolving cell line–specific expression patterns and enabling EV subtyping. Critically, the platform was validated on plasma-derived EVs from CRC patients and a healthy donor, where diagnostic performance exceeded that of the cell-line panel (AUC = 1.0 for metastatic CRC vs. healthy across all six spectral ratios; AUC = 0.58–1.0 for early-stage CRC vs. healthy). These results establish azide-FTIR spectroscopy as a rapid, label-efficient, and artifact-controlled platform for multiplexed EV biomarker detection, with direct evidence of its translatability to clinical liquid biopsy specimens rather than relying on cell-line data alone.
items.summary_zh: 研究构建了基于生物静默叠氮红外光谱和机器学习的外泌体检测平台，可同时定量CEA和CDH-17，并在结直肠癌患者血浆外泌体上进行验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 从细胞系扩展到临床血浆样本，并结合峰分解、信噪比和血清伪影对照证明检测特异性；早期结直肠癌样本的AUC范围较宽，临床泛化仍需更大队列。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞外囊泡（EV）是丰富且微创的癌症生物标志物来源，但与EV内部货物相比，EV表面糖蛋白的利用仍相对不足。在此，我们报告一种基于生物静默叠氮基的傅里叶变换红外（FTIR）光谱平台，用于直接从完整囊泡中同时、低标记地检测两种结直肠癌（CRC）EV表面生物标志物：癌胚抗原（CEA）和钙黏蛋白-17（CDH-17）。首先，利用脂质、蛋白质、碳水化合物和核酸光谱区域的内在生化指纹，通过多变量分析（PCA/SIMCA）和机器学习（PLS-DA）将来自5种CRC细胞系和1种非癌对照细胞系的EV区分开来，分类准确率最高达到97%。通过生物素化抗体和链霉亲和素-叠氮基对CEA和CDH-17进行选择性叠氮标记，在2000–2300 cm⁻¹生物静默窗口产生特异性振动信号，同时不扰动EV的天然光谱；通过高斯去卷积、定量信噪比分析（SNR = 315 ± 99）以及缓冲液/血清伪影对照确认峰的真实性。态密度重叠、余弦相关和约束非负最小二乘回归实现了从混合抗体光谱中同时对两种生物标志物进行解卷积和定量，解析了细胞系特异的表达模式，并实现EV分型。关键的是，在来源于CRC患者和一名健康供体的血浆EV上验证该平台时，其诊断性能超过了细胞系面板：在所有六种光谱比值上，转移性CRC与健康对照的AUC均为1.0；早期CRC与健康对照的AUC为0.58–1.0。这些结果表明，叠氮-FTIR光谱是一种快速、低标记且经过伪影控制的多重EV生物标志物检测平台，并直接证明其可转化到临床液体活检样本，而不只是依赖细胞系数据。

items.title: Joint recording of past and present transcriptomes reconstructs single-cell trajectories
items.abstract_or_text: Tracing molecular cell state transitions through development, homeostasis and disease is still beyond reach at single-cell resolution. We present scReMeMber-Seq, a methylation-based cell-memory recorder connecting past transcriptional states with present transcriptome and DNA methylome in individual cells. scReMeMber-Seq leverages pulse induction of DCM-Polr2b (TimeMachine) and single-cell methylome-transcriptome (scMT) sequencing for endpoint readout. In mouse neural stem cells (NSCs) and pancreatic organoids, single-cell DCM methylation profiles (scDCMome) accurately discriminate cell types. Over time, scDCMome also record NSC quiescence-activation state changes across multiple cell divisions. In zebrafish embryos, scDCMome resolve individual transcriptional trajectories from progenitor to neuron. Together, scReMeMber-Seq enables real time reconstruction of cellular trajectories, connecting past and present molecular states in single cells, at genome scale, across experimental systems, in vitro and in vivo.
items.summary_zh: scReMeMber-Seq 将甲基化细胞记忆记录与单细胞转录组和甲基组终点读取相连，用于重建细胞轨迹。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本在小鼠神经干细胞、胰腺类器官和斑马鱼胚胎中展示跨体外与体内系统的实验应用，为把既往与当前单细胞状态连接起来提供了新测量框架。
items.abstract_zh: 在单细胞分辨率下追踪发育、稳态和疾病过程中的分子细胞状态转换仍难以实现。我们提出 scReMeMber-Seq，这是一种基于甲基化的细胞记忆记录器，可在单个细胞中连接既往转录状态与当前转录组和 DNA 甲基组。scReMeMber-Seq 利用 DCM-Polr2b（TimeMachine）的脉冲诱导和单细胞甲基组—转录组（scMT）测序进行终点读取。在小鼠神经干细胞（NSCs）和胰腺类器官中，单细胞 DCM 甲基化谱（scDCMome）可准确区分细胞类型。随时间推移，scDCMome 还可记录跨多个细胞分裂的 NSC 静息—激活状态变化。在斑马鱼胚胎中，scDCMome 解析了从祖细胞到神经元的个体转录轨迹。总体而言，scReMeMber-Seq 能够在体外和体内实验系统中、在全基因组尺度上实时重建细胞轨迹，连接单细胞中过去与当前的分子状态。

items.title: Interoperability of standardised electronic healthcare records facilitates transfer learning of clinical language models
items.abstract_or_text: Objectives: To investigate whether standardising electronic healthcare record (EHR) data to the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP) common data model improves cross-dataset interoperability and enables transfer learning of clinical language models for prediction tasks. Materials and Methods: We used two UK datasets: Clinical Practice Research Datalink (CPRD) Aurum, restricted to London, and CPRD GOLD, covering all of England. Each dataset was independently mapped to OMOP standard concepts. A BERT-based transformer was pretrained on GOLD and fine-tuned on both datasets separately to predict 30-day emergency hospital readmission. An ablation study assessed the contribution of the three largest OMOP domains. Results: OMOP mapping was successful for 95.6% of CPRD GOLD and 86.2% of Aurum records. Models fine-tuned on Aurum achieved comparable or superior performance (AUC: 0.93, 95% CI 0.93-0.93) than models fine-tuned on GOLD (AUC: 0.91, 95% CI 0.91-0.92). Ablation results diverged between datasets: GOLD performed better without measurements, while Aurum performed better without drugs. Discussion: OMOP standardisation enabled effective transfer learning across datasets even in the presence of meaningful demographic differences, including ethnic composition and socioeconomic status. Divergence in ablation findings suggests that structural and content differences between primary care datasets influence downstream model behaviour. Incomplete vocabulary coverage within clinical language models also introduced data loss, representing a practical limitation for real-world deployment. Conclusion: OMOP standardisation supported interoperability and transfer learning for clinical prediction using language model with high predictive performance.
items.summary_zh: 在两个英国 CPRD 数据集中，OMOP 标准化支持临床语言模型迁移学习，用于 30 天急诊再入院预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本报告真实 EHR 数据映射、跨数据集微调及消融结果；模型性能不能直接说明可部署性，词表覆盖不足和数据集结构差异仍是现实限制。
items.abstract_zh: 目标：探究将电子健康记录（EHR）数据标准化为 Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership（OMOP）通用数据模型，是否能改善跨数据集互操作性，并使临床语言模型能够进行预测任务的迁移学习。材料与方法：我们使用两个英国数据集：仅限伦敦的 Clinical Practice Research Datalink（CPRD）Aurum，以及覆盖全英格兰的 CPRD GOLD。每个数据集均被独立映射到 OMOP 标准概念。一个基于 BERT 的 Transformer 在 GOLD 上预训练，并分别在两个数据集上微调，以预测 30 天急诊住院再入院。消融研究评估了三个最大 OMOP 域的贡献。结果：CPRD GOLD 的 95.6% 记录和 Aurum 的 86.2% 记录成功完成 OMOP 映射。在 Aurum 上微调的模型表现与在 GOLD 上微调的模型相当或更优（AUC：0.93，95% CI 0.93-0.93；相对 GOLD 的 AUC：0.91，95% CI 0.91-0.92）。两个数据集的消融结果不同：GOLD 在移除测量数据后表现更好，而 Aurum 在移除药物数据后表现更好。讨论：即使存在包括族群构成和社会经济地位在内的显著人口学差异，OMOP 标准化仍支持跨数据集的有效迁移学习。消融结果的差异表明，初级保健数据集之间的结构和内容差异会影响下游模型行为。临床语言模型内不完整的词表覆盖也造成数据丢失，构成真实世界部署的实际限制。结论：OMOP 标准化支持用于临床预测的语言模型的互操作性和迁移学习，并取得较高预测性能。

items.title: MatToolBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents in Real-World Materials Science Workflows
items.abstract_or_text: Multimodal GUI agents have achieved impressive results on general software benchmarks, yet their ability to operate professional scientific software remains largely unexplored. In materials science, sparse domain-specific web data, specialized interfaces, and tacit workflow conventions create blind spots that general-purpose pretraining cannot readily bridge. We present MatToolBench, the first real-environment benchmark for evaluating multimodal GUI agents on professional materials science software, comprising 204 tasks across 10 tools in three modalities: GUI operation, OriginPro scripting, and code-based database queries, all executed inside a Windows 11 VM. Each task is decomposed into fine-grained sub-criteria by domain experts, enabling interpretable partial-credit scoring; the GUI component of our multi-level evaluation pipeline achieves an average F1 of 0.98. For OriginPro figure-generation tasks, we further conduct a human-LLM agreement study to validate the use of a multimodal judge for secondary aesthetic assessment. Our experiments show that strong performance on general benchmarks does not transfer to professional scientific workflows, and that this gap is not a visual-grounding problem alone: failures arise from domain-specific operational knowledge, sparse pretraining coverage of scientific software, weak cross-tool artifact handoff, and critical states exposed only visually. Even the best model reaches only 25% success rate on GUI tasks and 45% on code tasks. MatToolBench therefore serves as a challenging diagnostic benchmark and real-environment testbed for data-scarce, knowledge-intensive scientific workflows.
items.summary_zh: MatToolBench在Windows 11虚拟机中评测多模态GUI代理操作材料科学专业软件的能力，覆盖10个工具、204项任务和GUI、OriginPro脚本、代码查询三种模式。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把材料科研软件中的隐性流程知识、跨工具交接和视觉状态纳入真实环境基准，显示通用基准成绩难以迁移；最佳模型在GUI任务上成功率仅25%，说明仍存在明显实用瓶颈。
items.abstract_zh: 多模态GUI代理在通用软件基准上已取得令人印象深刻的结果，但其操作专业科学软件的能力仍基本未被探索。在材料科学中，稀疏的领域专属网络数据、专门化界面和隐性的工作流惯例造成了通用预训练难以弥补的盲点。我们提出MatToolBench，这是首个在真实环境中评估多模态GUI代理操作材料科学专业软件的基准，包含在Windows 11虚拟机中执行的10个工具、204项任务，以及三种模式：GUI操作、OriginPro脚本和基于代码的数据库查询。每项任务都由领域专家分解为细粒度子标准，从而实现可解释的部分得分；我们的多层评估流程中，GUI组件达到0.98的平均F1。对于OriginPro图形生成任务，我们进一步开展人类-LLM一致性研究，以验证使用多模态评判器进行次级美学评价的可行性。实验表明，在通用基准上的强性能无法迁移到专业科学工作流，这一差距也不仅仅是视觉定位问题：失败源于领域特定的操作知识、科学软件预训练覆盖不足、跨工具产物交接薄弱，以及只有在视觉上暴露的关键状态。即使是最佳模型，在GUI任务上的成功率也只有25%，在代码任务上的成功率为45%。因此，MatToolBench可作为数据稀缺、知识密集型科学工作流的挑战性诊断基准和真实环境试验台。

items.title: Prion Protein Deficiency Results in Synaptic, Neural Network and Behavioral Alterations
items.abstract_or_text: The cellular form of the prion protein (PrPC) is known for its involvement in the pathogenesis of prion diseases. Recent research implicates the physiological isoform of PrP in neuronal development, excitability, and synaptic plasticity, as well as in other biological processes. However, its precise function in the development and function of neurons remains poorly understood. Here, we investigated its role during different developmental stages, both in vitro and in vivo, using different PrP knock-out (KO) mouse lines (Prnp-/-). Prion protein KO neurons cultured on microelectrode arrays (MEAs) displayed altered network dynamics compared to wild type cultures, comprising reduced burst frequency, and abnormal spike patterns, indicative of impaired function of the synaptic circuitry. These functional alterations were associated with a reduced expression of key presynaptic and postsynaptic proteins, including elements of the SNARE complex and regulators of excitation-inhibition balance. Similar molecular changes were also confirmed in a second Prnp-/- model, suggesting that PrPC is directly involved in these mechanisms regardless of genetic backgrounds. Alterations in neuronal networks were traceable into adulthood: in vivo recordings in adult Prnp-/- mice revealed increased neuronal responses to visual danger stimuli, which correlated with behaviorally increased fear responses to those stimuli. Together, our findings support a critical role for PrPC in the maintenance of functional neuronal networks, from mature cortical neurons in vitro to behaviorally mature relevant circuits in vivo, beyond genomic background. These results indicate that PrPC acts as a key regulator of synaptic function both in physiological and pathological conditions.
items.summary_zh: 多个 Prnp-/- 小鼠模型显示 PrPC 缺失伴随突触蛋白、神经网络动力学和恐惧反应改变。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本跨体外 MEA、第二个敲除模型和成年小鼠体内记录给出一致证据，支持 PrPC 与突触功能相关；结果尚不能单独确定其分子机制。
items.abstract_zh: 朊蛋白的细胞形式（PrPC）因参与朊病毒病的发病机制而为人所知。近期研究提示，PrP 的生理同工型参与神经元发育、兴奋性和突触可塑性，以及其他生物过程。然而，其在神经元发育和功能中的确切作用仍知之甚少。我们在体外和体内、使用不同的 PrP 敲除（KO）小鼠品系（Prnp-/-），研究了其在不同发育阶段中的作用。于微电极阵列（MEA）上培养的朊蛋白 KO 神经元与野生型培养物相比表现出改变的网络动力学，包括爆发频率降低和异常放电模式，提示突触回路功能受损。这些功能改变伴随关键突触前和突触后蛋白表达降低，包括 SNARE 复合体元件和兴奋—抑制平衡调节因子。在第二个 Prnp-/- 模型中也证实了类似的分子改变，提示无论遗传背景如何，PrPC 都直接参与这些机制。神经网络改变可追踪至成年期：成年 Prnp-/- 小鼠的体内记录显示，其对视觉危险刺激的神经元反应增加，并与对这些刺激行为上增加的恐惧反应相关。总体而言，我们的发现支持 PrPC 在维持功能性神经网络中具有关键作用，涵盖体外成熟皮层神经元至体内行为成熟的相关回路，且不受遗传背景限制。这些结果表明，PrPC 在生理和病理条件下均是突触功能的关键调节因子。

items.title: NeuroDyn-EEG: An Interpretable Pre-trained Model for EEG Based on Neural Dynamics
items.abstract_or_text: Clinical scalp electroencephalography (EEG) offers a noninvasive window into neural dynamics of neuropsychiatric disorders. However, discriminative deep models often lack anatomically indexed physiological interpretability. We propose NeuroDyn-EEG, a pretraining framework integrating generative priors from neural dynamics. It couples an extended Jansen-Rit neural mass model, leadfield-based source projection, and simulation-based parameter inversion. Trained on synthetic parameter-EEG pairs within physiological ranges, NeuroDyn-EEG estimates 11 regional parameter families across 90 AAL regions plus one global parameter from standard 19-channel EEG, using only ~2.43M trainable parameters. We evaluate the framework across three levels. First, controlled simulations demonstrate robust parameter recovery under diverse noise conditions, while real resting-state EEG evaluations confirm spectral and phase consistency in an inverse-forward closed loop. Second, on four clinical benchmarks (AD65, PD31, Figshare MDD, and TUAB), NeuroDyn-EEG achieves competitive classification performance, securing the highest BACC, AUROC, and AUCPR on PD31 and MDD, and highest BACC on AD65. Third, post hoc regional analyses reveal disease-specific alterations: local synaptic connectivity C_1 involves the most altered regions in AD65, whereas the firing threshold theta ranks first in MDD, offering testable mechanistic hypotheses. Overall, NeuroDyn-EEG maps scalp EEG to anatomically indexed dynamical parameters, bridging representation learning and mechanistic neurophysiology. Code: https://github.com/Gnosis-Neurodynamics/NeuroDyn-EEG.
items.summary_zh: NeuroDyn-EEG 用神经动力学生成先验将 19 导 EEG 映射为解剖定位的动力学参数，并在四个临床基准中评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本同时报告仿真参数恢复、闭环一致性、临床基准分类和公开代码；疾病相关参数是可检验的机制假设，不是已确认的病理机制或临床诊断工具。
items.abstract_zh: 临床头皮脑电图（EEG）为观察神经精神疾病的神经动力学提供了无创窗口。然而，判别式深度模型通常缺乏按解剖位置索引的生理可解释性。我们提出 NeuroDyn-EEG，一个整合神经动力学生成先验的预训练框架。它结合扩展的 Jansen-Rit 神经质量模型、基于 leadfield 的源投影和基于仿真的参数反演。NeuroDyn-EEG 在生理范围内的合成参数—EEG 配对数据上训练，仅使用约 2.43M 个可训练参数，即可从标准 19 导 EEG 估计 90 个 AAL 区域的 11 类区域参数及 1 个全局参数。我们在三个层面评估该框架。首先，受控仿真显示其在多种噪声条件下可稳健恢复参数，而真实静息态 EEG 评估在逆—正向闭环中确认了频谱和相位一致性。其次，在四个临床基准（AD65、PD31、Figshare MDD 和 TUAB）上，NeuroDyn-EEG 获得有竞争力的分类性能，在 PD31 和 MDD 上取得最高 BACC、AUROC 和 AUCPR，在 AD65 上取得最高 BACC。第三，事后区域分析揭示了疾病特异性改变：局部突触连接 C_1 涉及 AD65 中改变最多的区域，而放电阈值 theta 在 MDD 中排名第一，提供了可检验的机制假设。总体而言，NeuroDyn-EEG 将头皮 EEG 映射至按解剖位置索引的动力学参数，连接表征学习与机制性神经生理学。代码：https://github.com/Gnosis-Neurodynamics/NeuroDyn-EEG。

items.title: Learning to Prove, Not Just to Answer: Reinforcement Learning from Formal Verification for Natural-Language Logical Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for natural-language logical reasoning, where the final answer is easy to check but the proof behind it is not. In natural-language logical reasoning, an intermediate conclusion should follow from its premises, and the resulting derivation should support the final answer. Existing methods lack machine-checkable verification of intermediate conclusions and answer-supporting proof dependencies, so they may assign credit to invalid or answer-irrelevant steps. We propose Proof-R1, an RL framework from formal verification that trains LLMs to construct verifiable proofs for natural-language logical reasoning. Proof-R1 admits a generated conclusion into the verified proof state only when the corresponding reasoning action satisfies the proof obligations through UNSAT-based machine-checkable formal verification. Proof-R1 also recovers the answer-supporting dependency closure to trace the proof structure of the final answer and align outcome credit with the proof dependencies. Experiments demonstrate that Proof-R1 improves answer accuracy across three logical reasoning benchmarks and four backbone models and outperforms training-free agents and training-based methods in terms of reasoning-process verifiability.
items.summary_zh: Proof-R1 将自然语言逻辑推理训练改造成带形式验证的证明构造任务：只有通过基于 UNSAT 的机器可检验义务检查的结论，才能进入已验证证明状态，并追踪支撑最终答案的依赖闭包。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把“答对”与“证明步骤有效且确实支撑答案”区分开来，提供了可检查的中间步骤和依赖关系；摘要还报告了三个逻辑推理基准、四个骨干模型上的结果。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地用于自然语言逻辑推理，其中最终答案容易检查，但背后的证明并不容易检查。在自然语言逻辑推理中，中间结论应当由其前提推出，而完整推导应当支撑最终答案。现有方法缺乏对中间结论以及支撑答案的证明依赖进行机器可检查的验证，因此可能会给无效步骤或与答案无关的步骤赋予信用。我们提出 Proof-R1，一种来自形式验证的强化学习框架，用于训练 LLM 为自然语言逻辑推理构造可验证证明。只有当相应的推理动作通过基于 UNSAT 的机器可检查形式验证、满足证明义务时，Proof-R1 才会将生成的结论纳入已验证证明状态。Proof-R1 还会恢复支撑答案的依赖闭包，以追踪最终答案的证明结构，并使结果信用与证明依赖相一致。实验表明，Proof-R1 在三个逻辑推理基准和四个骨干模型上提高了答案准确率，并在推理过程可验证性方面优于无需训练的智能体和基于训练的方法。
items.author_line: Qili Zhang, Qianren Mao, Hanze Cai, Kaiming Zhao, Yuening He, Xihan Lei, Yashuo Luo, Hanwen Hao, Yutong Gu, Likang Xiao, Zhijun Chen, Weifeng Jiang, Haoyi Zhou, Jianxin Li

items.title: Probability is Not Enough: Exploring and Counting Divergent Tokens for Reasoning Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: As the chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities of large language models improve, evaluating and calibrating their reasoning confidence is becoming increasingly important for quantifying the uncertainty of their answers. Current methods for estimating the confidence of large language models are generally based on probabilities of selected key tokens, but the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Our pilot study finds that replacing selected token probabilities with coarse substitutes can also improve calibration, motivating us to further explore effective signals of model confidence. We introduce Divergent Token Confidence (DTC), a framework that estimates confidence by counting tokens at which two models strongly disagree during decoding. DTC identifies these divergent tokens using the Jensen-Shannon divergence between next-token distributions evaluated along the same reasoning trajectory. We find that their count is almost negatively associated with answer accuracy, thereby serving as a simple yet effective signal for uncertainty quantification. DTC supports both white-box and black-box evaluation using auxiliary models, without explicit training and affecting the generation process. Experiments across multiple model families and six mathematical benchmarks demonstrate improved calibration over probability-based and verbalized baselines. Under white-box evaluation, the count-only estimator achieves an average expected calibration error of 13.0%, compared with 32.7%-42.4% for standard full-sequence confidence methods. In black-box settings, it also improves calibration over the original verbalized scores. For example, mean expected calibration error falls from 32.1%-40.2% to 13.7%-16.3% on DeepSeek-V3.2. These findings provide new insights for improving reasoning uncertainty quantification in large language models. The code is released at https://github.com/szu-tera/DTC.git.
items.summary_zh: Divergent Token Confidence（DTC）通过统计两个模型在同一推理轨迹上下一词分布显著分歧的 token 数量，估计 LLM 推理的不确定性；在六个数学基准上报告了优于概率式和口头置信度基线的校准结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它给出了不改变生成过程、可支持白盒和黑盒评估的置信度信号，并用期望校准误差提供了可复核的数学推理可靠性指标。
items.abstract_zh: 随着大型语言模型的思维链推理能力提升，评估并校准其推理置信度对于量化答案不确定性变得越来越重要。当前估计大型语言模型置信度的方法通常基于所选关键 token 的概率，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们的初步研究发现，用粗粒度替代量取代所选 token 概率同样可以改善校准，这促使我们进一步探索有效的模型置信度信号。我们提出 Divergent Token Confidence（DTC），一种通过统计两个模型在解码过程中强烈分歧的 token 来估计置信度的框架。DTC 使用沿同一推理轨迹计算的下一 token 分布之间的 Jensen-Shannon 散度来识别这些分歧 token。我们发现，分歧 token 的数量几乎与答案准确率负相关，因此可作为一种简单而有效的不确定性量化信号。DTC 支持使用辅助模型进行白盒和黑盒评估，不需要显式训练，也不影响生成过程。在多个模型家族和六个数学基准上的实验表明，与基于概率和口头表达的基线相比，DTC 改善了校准。在白盒评估中，仅使用计数的估计器取得了 13.0% 的平均期望校准误差，而标准的全序列置信度方法为 32.7%–42.4%。在黑盒设置中，它也改善了相对于原始口头分数的校准。例如，在 DeepSeek-V3.2 上，平均期望校准误差从 32.1%–40.2% 降至 13.7%–16.3%。这些发现为改进大型语言模型的推理不确定性量化提供了新的认识。代码已发布于 https://github.com/szu-tera/DTC.git。

items.title: Curvature-Aware Flow Matching for Molecular Structure Generation
items.abstract_or_text: Generative models produce three-dimensional molecular structures with high geometric accuracy, yet they are trained on distributions of atomic coordinates without explicit access to the underlying physics. The potential energy surface (PES) describes how the energy changes around a molecular geometry, and the RMSD between a generated structure and its reference captures this local landscape only indirectly. Supervising the PES during training could close this gap, but conformers and transition states (TSs) are stationary points at which the forces vanish, so first-order quantities carry little information about them. What remains is the local curvature, encoded in the Hessian of the PES. Quantum-chemical Hessians are too expensive to be available at the scale required for training, but recently proposed machine-learned predictors make curvature inexpensive enough to supervise directly. We introduce CurvFM, a flow matching (FM) formulation whose training objective constrains the curvature at the generated structure. A frozen Hessian prediction model is evaluated at the generated endpoint and at the reference structure, which removes the need for quantum-chemical Hessians and keeps the residual cheap enough to impose at every training step. Across TS and conformer generation, CurvFM substantially improves physical fidelity at unchanged global structural accuracy, reducing the median deviation in maximum force by 63% on GEOM-QM9 and raising the fraction of valid TSs by up to 10% across three reaction datasets.
items.summary_zh: CurvFM在流匹配训练中加入由机器学习Hessian预测器提供的势能面曲率约束，在保持整体结构精度不变的同时改善构象和过渡态生成的物理保真度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在GEOM-QM9上将最大力中位偏差降低63%，并在三个反应数据集上将有效过渡态比例最多提高10%；依赖冻结的机器学习Hessian预测器，量子化学Hessian本身未用于逐步训练。
items.abstract_zh: 生成模型能够以很高的几何精度产生三维分子结构，但其训练基于原子坐标分布，并未显式获得底层物理信息。势能面（PES）描述分子几何附近能量如何变化，而生成结构与参考结构之间的RMSD只能间接反映这一局部景观。在训练中对PES进行监督可能弥合这一差距，但构象和过渡态（TS）是力为零的驻点，因此一阶量对它们包含的信息很少。剩下的信息是由PES的Hessian编码的局部曲率。量子化学Hessian成本过高，无法以训练所需的规模获得，但近期提出的机器学习预测器使曲率足够廉价，可以直接用于监督。我们提出CurvFM，一种流匹配（FM）形式，其训练目标约束生成结构处的曲率。在生成端点和参考结构处分别使用冻结的Hessian预测模型，从而无需量子化学Hessian，并使残差足够低廉，可以在每个训练步骤中施加。在过渡态和构象生成任务中，CurvFM在保持整体结构精度不变的同时显著提高物理保真度：在GEOM-QM9上将最大力的中位偏差降低63%，并在三个反应数据集上将有效过渡态比例最多提高10%。

items.title: StateFlux: DFT-Validated Quantum Reactivity across Predicted Metabolic State Networks Shows Limited Incremental Value for Broad Toxicity Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Mechanistic molecular representations are increasingly used to supplement parent structure with protonation, metabolism, and quantum-chemical reactivity, but added physical detail does not necessarily provide predictive information beyond structure. StateFlux represents each drug as a network of chemical and predicted metabolic states with node-level GFN2-xTB properties and edge-resolved changes in ionization potential, electron affinity, electrophilicity, solvation, and local reactivity. On a locked DILIrank 2.0 development set (n = 376; 156 positive and 220 negative), 10 × 5 scaffold-grouped validation gave AUROC/AUPRC values of 0.8249/0.7727 for ECFP, 0.8049/0.7430 for ECFP + FluxCore, and 0.8010/0.7261 for ECFP + StateFluxCore. Strict temporal and scaffold-novel tests showed no consistent gain, and an independent 5,367-compound genotoxicity transfer benchmark reproduced the pattern (AUROC 0.7765 for ECFP versus 0.7732 for StateFluxCore). To separate limited predictive utility from inaccurate low-cost quantum chemistry, 24 parent-to-metabolite transformations were evaluated with 144 ωB97X-D/6-31+G*/SMD single-point calculations. GFN2-xTB closely tracked DFT changes in electrophilicity (Pearson r = 0.963; MAE = 0.408 eV; 79.2% sign agreement). Thus, transformation-induced quantum reactivity can be consistent with higher-level DFT without providing reliable incremental information for broad toxicity classification. Quantum-chemical fidelity and predictive utility should therefore be evaluated as separate claims in chemical machine learning.
items.summary_zh: StateFlux把药物及其预测代谢状态表示成化学状态网络，并用GFN2-xTB反应性特征和DFT对照检验其对DILI及遗传毒性预测的增量价值。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 严格的时间和骨架新颖性测试显示，加入量子反应性并未稳定改善广义毒性分类，同时以144次DFT单点计算验证了低成本量子化学的一致性，清楚区分了物理保真度与预测效用。
items.abstract_zh: 机制性分子表示正越来越多地用于在母体结构之外补充质子化、代谢和量子化学反应性，但增加物理细节并不一定能提供超越结构本身的预测信息。StateFlux将每种药物表示为由化学状态和预测代谢状态组成的网络，节点包含GFN2-xTB性质，边则记录电离势、电子亲和能、亲电性、溶剂化和局部反应性的变化。在锁定的DILIrank 2.0开发集（n = 376；156个阳性和220个阴性）上，10 × 5次按骨架分组的验证得到：ECFP的AUROC/AUPRC为0.8249/0.7727，ECFP + FluxCore为0.8049/0.7430，ECFP + StateFluxCore为0.8010/0.7261。严格的时间外推和新骨架测试没有显示一致的增益；在独立的5,367种化合物遗传毒性迁移基准上也复现了这一模式（ECFP的AUROC为0.7765，StateFluxCore为0.7732）。为区分有限的预测效用与低成本量子化学的不准确性，我们使用144次ωB97X-D/6-31+G*/SMD单点计算评估了24个母体到代谢物的转化。GFN2-xTB能够紧密追踪DFT得到的亲电性变化（Pearson r = 0.963；MAE = 0.408 eV；符号一致率79.2%）。因此，转化诱导的量子反应性可以与更高水平的DFT保持一致，却不能为广义毒性分类提供可靠的增量信息。在化学机器学习中，应将量子化学保真度和预测效用作为彼此独立的主张进行评估。

items.title: Integration of Multidimensional Genetic and Single- Cell Analyses to Identify Potential Drug Targets and a Clinical Risk Prediction Model for Cervical Cancer
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background : Genetic susceptibility to cervical cancer is closely associated with dysregulation of the tumor microenvironment. However, genetic mapping, causal inference, and single-cell functional characterization have rarely been integrated within a unified analytical framework, limiting the translational potential of candidate therapeutic targets. Methods : This study integrated conditional and joint association analysis (COJO), Multi-marker Analysis of GenoMic Annotation (MAGMA), two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR), differential expression analysis, chromosomal mapping, gene correlation analysis, immune infiltration analysis, gene-immune cell association analysis, machine learning, and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq). COJO and MAGMA were first used to identify cervical cancer susceptibility genes and independent genetic signals from genome-wide association study (GWAS) data. MR was then performed to assess potential causal associations between gene expression and cervical cancer. Differential expression and genomic localization analyses were used to prioritize core genes. Their potential immune-related mechanisms were investigated through immune infiltration and gene-immune cell association analyses. Machine-learning models were used to evaluate predictive performance and construct a nomogram. Finally, scRNA-seq was used to characterize the cell-type-specific expression of the prioritized genes. Results : COJO and MAGMA identified 12 independent genetic signals corresponding to eight susceptibility genes. MR supported associations of genetically predicted expression of SERPINB13 (IVW: OR = 1.72, 95% CI = 1.48-1.99, P = 2.3 x 10^-8), PDCD1LG2 (IVW: OR = 1.58, 95% CI = 1.35-1.85, P = 7.6 x 10^-7), SERPINF2 (IVW: OR = 1.45, 95% CI = 1.23-1.71, P = 3.1 x 10^-5), and MMP1 (IVW: OR = 1.36, 95% CI = 1.15-1.61, P = 4.8 x 10^-4) with cervical cancer. All four genes were significantly upregulated in cervical cancer tissues (FDR 0.5, P Conclusions : This multidimensional analysis identified SERPINB13, PDCD1LG2, SERPINF2, and MMP1 as candidate therapeutic targets and potential predictors of cervical cancer. The findings suggest that these genes may contribute to cervical carcinogenesis through immune-microenvironment regulation and may support future risk-stratification research. Experimental and prospective clinical validation is required before clinical application.
items.summary_zh: 研究整合 GWAS、MR、机器学习与 scRNA-seq，提出 SERPINB13、PDCD1LG2、SERPINF2 和 MMP1 为宫颈癌候选靶点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本整合遗传关联、单细胞定位和风险建模；MR 结果支持遗传预测表达与宫颈癌的关联，但作者明确指出仍需实验和前瞻性临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：宫颈癌的遗传易感性与肿瘤微环境失调密切相关。然而，遗传定位、因果推断和单细胞功能表征很少在统一分析框架中整合，从而限制了候选治疗靶点的转化潜力。方法：本研究整合了条件与联合关联分析（COJO）、基因组注释多标记分析（MAGMA）、双样本孟德尔随机化（MR）、差异表达分析、染色体定位、基因相关性分析、免疫浸润分析、基因—免疫细胞关联分析、机器学习和单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）。首先使用 COJO 和 MAGMA 从全基因组关联研究（GWAS）数据中识别宫颈癌易感基因和独立遗传信号。随后进行 MR，以评估基因表达与宫颈癌之间潜在的因果关联。利用差异表达和基因组定位分析优先筛选核心基因。通过免疫浸润和基因—免疫细胞关联分析，考察其潜在的免疫相关机制。使用机器学习模型评估预测性能并构建列线图。最后，利用 scRNA-seq 表征优先基因的细胞类型特异性表达。结果：COJO 和 MAGMA 识别出 12 个独立遗传信号，对应 8 个易感基因。MR 支持遗传预测的 SERPINB13（IVW：OR = 1.72，95% CI = 1.48-1.99，P = 2.3 x 10^-8）、PDCD1LG2（IVW：OR = 1.58，95% CI = 1.35-1.85，P = 7.6 x 10^-7）、SERPINF2（IVW：OR = 1.45，95% CI = 1.23-1.71，P = 3.1 x 10^-5）和 MMP1（IVW：OR = 1.36，95% CI = 1.15-1.61，P = 4.8 x 10^-4）表达与宫颈癌之间的关联。四个基因在宫颈癌组织中均显著上调（FDR 0.5，P）。结论：该多维分析将 SERPINB13、PDCD1LG2、SERPINF2 和 MMP1 识别为宫颈癌候选治疗靶点和潜在预测因子。研究结果提示，这些基因可能通过免疫微环境调控参与宫颈癌发生，并可能支持未来风险分层研究。在临床应用前仍需要实验和前瞻性临床验证。

items.title: Identification and experimental validation of biomarkers associated with lipotoxicity in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease through transcriptomic and single-cell RNA sequencing analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Studies have suggested that lipotoxicity may play a significant role in the etiology of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). However, the precise involvement of lipotoxicity-related genes (LRGs) in COPD remains unclear. This study aimed to identify and validate biomarkers associated with LRGs in COPD, potentially paving the way for the development of targeted therapeutic strategies. Methods In the study, COPD-related datasets were sourced from a public database. Biomarkers were ascertained through differential expression analysis, machine learning, and gene expression analyses. A nomogram was developed and evaluated based on these biomarkers. To further explore the underlying biological mechanisms of COPD, functional enrichment analysis, immune infiltration analysis, drug prediction, single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), and reverse transcription quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR) analyses were conducted. Results APRT and S100A8 were ascertained as biomarkers for COPD. Notably, APRT exhibited notably lower expression in COPD samples, while S100A8 showed notably higher expression. RT-qPCR analysis further supported these findings. A nomogram was then developed and validated, with the calibration curve indicating its effective ability to predict COPD risk (P = 0.395 in the Hosmer-Lemeshow test). Both biomarkers were found to be significantly co-enriched in the "focal adhesion" pathway. Additionally, 3 immune cell types with notably differential infiltration were identified, and both APRT and S100A8 showed a significant correlation with neutrophils. Furthermore, 27 drugs (such as alteplase and relaxin) targeting APRT, as well as methotrexate targeting S100A8, were predicted. Finally, scRNA-seq analysis ascertained macrophages as a key cell type in COPD. Dynamic expression patterns of both biomarkers were observed during macrophage differentiation: APRT first increases, then decreases, and increases again, while S100A8 initially rises and then declines. Conclusion This study ascertained APRT and S100A8 as biomarkers associated with lipotoxicity in COPD, providing valuable insights that could aid in the development of targeted therapies.
items.summary_zh: 公共队列、scRNA-seq 与 RT-qPCR 将 APRT 和 S100A8 提出为与 COPD 脂毒性相关的候选标志物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本包含 RT-qPCR 支持和单细胞表达动态，但药物仅为计算预测，标志物及靶向治疗价值仍需外部队列和功能实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：研究提示脂毒性可能在慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）的病因学中发挥重要作用。然而，脂毒性相关基因（LRGs）在 COPD 中的确切参与情况仍不清楚。本研究旨在识别并验证 COPD 中与 LRGs 相关的生物标志物，可能为靶向治疗策略的开发铺平道路。方法：研究从公共数据库获取 COPD 相关数据集。通过差异表达分析、机器学习和基因表达分析确定生物标志物。基于这些标志物建立并评估了一个列线图。为进一步探索 COPD 的潜在生物学机制，进行了功能富集分析、免疫浸润分析、药物预测、单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）和逆转录定量 PCR（RT-qPCR）分析。结果：APRT 和 S100A8 被确定为 COPD 的生物标志物。值得注意的是，APRT 在 COPD 样本中的表达显著较低，而 S100A8 的表达显著较高。RT-qPCR 分析进一步支持了这些发现。随后建立并验证了一个列线图，校准曲线显示其具有有效预测 COPD 风险的能力（Hosmer-Lemeshow 检验 P = 0.395）。发现两个标志物均在“focal adhesion”通路中显著共同富集。此外，识别出 3 种浸润显著不同的免疫细胞类型，且 APRT 和 S100A8 均与中性粒细胞显著相关。进一步预测出靶向 APRT 的 27 种药物（如 alteplase 和 relaxin），以及靶向 S100A8 的 methotrexate。最后，scRNA-seq 分析将巨噬细胞确定为 COPD 中的关键细胞类型。在巨噬细胞分化过程中观察到两个标志物的动态表达模式：APRT 先升高、后降低、再升高，而 S100A8 最初升高后下降。结论：本研究将 APRT 和 S100A8 确定为与 COPD 脂毒性相关的生物标志物，为可能有助于开发靶向疗法提供了有价值的见解。
items.author_line: Li j, Luo X, Zhang X, Zhao Q, Wang R

items.title: BiomiX 3.0: A user-friendly platform for democratized multi-omics integration with graph-based learning.
items.abstract_or_text: Background Multi-omics integration has emerged as a powerful strategy to decode the molecular complexity of biological systems. However, the diversity of available methods, each designed with distinct assumptions, objectives, and computational requirements, makes method selection, usage and interpretation challenging for nonexpert users. Here we present BiomiX 3.0, an updated version of the BiomiX platform that extends its integration capabilities with four additional methods: Similarity Network Fusion (SNF), NEighborhood-based Multi-Omics clustering (NEMO), Data Integration Analysis for Biomarker discovery using Latent variable approaches for Omics studies (DIABLO), and PRAMIGO (Phenotyping netwoRk Application for Multi-omics InteGratiOn), a novel supervised heterogeneous graph transformer (HGT) introduced in this work. Results We benchmarked all five methods, MOFA, DIABLO, SNF, NEMO, and PRAMIGO, on two independent multiomics datasets derived from a Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) cohort comparing IGHV-mutated and unmutated patients, and a pulmonary tuberculosis (PTB) cohort versus healthy controls. Supervised methods (DIABLO, PRAMIGO) consistently achieved higher condition-specific discrimination as measured by the Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) and the Adjusted Mutual Information (AMI). In contrast, unsupervised methods (SNF, NEMO) revealed alternative patient stratifications driven by independent sources of biological variance while MOFA performed in a semi-supervised way occupies an intermediate position, capturing latent factors that explain both disease-associated and orthogonal sources of variance. Systematic gene-centric analysis of the top-ranked features prioritized by each method was supported by manual biological annotation of shared and method-specific signals. Across cohorts, we annotated 154 shared features (116 genes, 38 metabolites) and 60 method-unique features per cohort, demonstrating that no single integration strategy captures the full landscape of biologically relevant signals. In the CLL cohort, shared features spanned B-cell receptor biology, innate immune signaling, RAS/MAPK activation, and epigenetic regulation, while methodunique features revealed supervised-method-specific insights into vesicle trafficking (DIABLO), immune checkpoints (MOFA), and ncRNA regulation (PRAMIGO). In the PTB cohort, a convergent interferon/innate immune signature dominated shared features across all methods. Still, method-unique analysis uncovered DIABLO-specific acylcarnitine metabolic reprogramming, MOFA-specific restoration of lysosomal trafficking, and PRAMIGO-specific {gamma}{delta} T-cell and immunoglobulin repertoire diversity. Across both cohorts, SNF and NEMO proved useful for detecting biological and technical sources of variation that were orthogonal to the primary condition of interest. Ultimately, PRAMIGO uniquely enables the construction of heterogeneous graphs modeling cross-modal molecular interactions, uncovering epigenetic co-regulation programs in CLL and multi-omics inflammatory modules in PTB that are difficult to identify using conventional integration approaches. Conclusions BiomiX 3.0 provides a graphical user interface (GUI) multi-method integration environment that democratizes access to state-of-the-art multi-omics analysis. By combining both unsupervised and supervised integration strategies within a unified platform and introducing graph-based learning through PRAMIGO, BiomiX 3.0 enables researchers across disciplines with complementary tools to interrogate the biological sources of variation in their data, without requiring bioinformatics expertise.
items.summary_zh: BiomiX 3.0 在统一 GUI 中比较五种多组学整合方法，并新增异质图 Transformer PRAMIGO。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本在两个独立多组学队列比较方法，并保留不同方法得到的互补信号；它支持方法选择应与研究问题相匹配，而非宣称单一方案普遍最优。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：多组学整合已成为解码生物系统分子复杂性的强大策略。然而，可用方法具有不同的假设、目标和计算要求，这种多样性使非专业用户难以选择、使用和解释方法。这里我们提出 BiomiX 3.0，这是 BiomiX 平台的更新版本，通过另外四种方法扩展其整合能力：Similarity Network Fusion（SNF）、NEighborhood-based Multi-Omics clustering（NEMO）、Data Integration Analysis for Biomarker discovery using Latent variable approaches for Omics studies（DIABLO），以及本研究引入的新型监督式异质图 Transformer（HGT）PRAMIGO（Phenotyping netwoRk Application for Multi-omics InteGratiOn）。结果：我们在两个独立多组学数据集上对五种方法 MOFA、DIABLO、SNF、NEMO 和 PRAMIGO 进行了基准测试；这两个数据集分别来自比较 IGHV 突变和未突变患者的慢性淋巴细胞白血病（CLL）队列，以及比较肺结核（PTB）队列与健康对照的队列。由调整兰德指数（ARI）和调整互信息（AMI）衡量，监督方法（DIABLO、PRAMIGO）始终获得更高的条件特异性判别能力。相比之下，无监督方法（SNF、NEMO）揭示了由独立生物变异来源驱动的替代患者分层；而 MOFA 以半监督方式运行，处于中间位置，捕捉同时解释疾病相关和正交变异来源的潜在因子。对每种方法优先筛选的高排名特征进行了系统的以基因为中心的分析，并以对共享和方法特异性信号的人工生物学注释作为支持。跨队列而言，我们注释了 154 个共享特征（116 个基因、38 个代谢物）及每个队列 60 个方法独有特征，表明没有单一整合策略能捕捉具有生物学相关性的信号全貌。在 CLL 队列中，共享特征涵盖 B 细胞受体生物学、固有免疫信号、RAS/MAPK 激活和表观遗传调控，而方法独有特征揭示了囊泡转运（DIABLO）、免疫检查点（MOFA）和 ncRNA 调控（PRAMIGO）方面的监督方法特异性见解。在 PTB 队列中，趋同的 interferon/固有免疫特征主导了各方法的共享信号。尽管如此，方法独有分析揭示了 DIABLO 特异的 acylcarnitine 代谢重编程、MOFA 特异的 lysosomal trafficking 恢复，以及 PRAMIGO 特异的 {gamma}{delta} T 细胞和免疫球蛋白受体库多样性。跨两个队列，SNF 和 NEMO 均证明可用于检测与主要关注条件正交的生物学和技术变异来源。最终，PRAMIGO 独特地能够构建模拟跨模态分子相互作用的异质图，发现 CLL 中难以用常规整合方法识别的表观遗传共调控程序和 PTB 中的多组学炎症模块。结论：BiomiX 3.0 提供了一个图形用户界面（GUI）多方法整合环境，使最先进的多组学分析更易获得。通过在统一平台中结合无监督和监督整合策略，并通过 PRAMIGO 引入图学习，BiomiX 3.0 使不同学科的研究人员能够利用互补工具考察数据中生物学变异的来源，而不需要生物信息学专业知识。

items.title: On the Limits of Metacognitive Monitoring in LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: Reliable decisions depend on recognizing when an answer may be wrong. In biological cognition, metacognitive monitoring can dissociate from task performance, raising the question of how closely solving and judging are linked in language models. Here we study the confidence reports of four frontier models across 15 benchmarks. High task accuracy can coexist with weak error discrimination: a model solves 97% of competition mathematics problems while its answer-time confidence ranks correct answers above errors barely better than chance. Confidence separates correct answers from errors more effectively on questions solved by a separate reference model, while review brings limited improvement on reference-hard questions. Aggregate discrimination also rewards ranking correct answers on easy questions above errors on hard ones, which question-only forecasts already do well. Cross-evaluation helps most where the evaluator answered correctly, and errors shared by the two models usually retain high confidence. Hard questions and shared errors remain difficult targets for prompted self-review and peer oversight, even in models with strong problem-solving performance.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在 15 个基准上考察四个前沿模型的置信度监控，发现高任务准确率可以与近乎随机的错误区分能力并存，且共享错误往往仍保持高置信度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它直接检验模型能否识别自身错误，提醒不能把高解题率或自我复核表现简单等同于可靠的元认知监控。
items.abstract_zh: 可靠的决策依赖于识别答案可能出错的时刻。在生物认知中，元认知监控可以与任务表现脱钩，这引出了一个问题：语言模型中的解题与判断究竟有多紧密。我们在 15 个基准上研究四个前沿模型的置信度报告。高任务准确率可以与较弱的错误区分能力并存：某个模型能够解决 97% 的竞赛数学题，但其在回答时的置信度将正确答案排在错误答案之前的能力仅略高于随机水平。当问题由另一个参考模型解决时，置信度对正确答案和错误答案的区分更有效；而对于参考模型也难以解决的问题，复核带来的改进有限。总体区分能力还会把“简单问题上的正确答案”排在“困难问题上的错误答案”之前，而仅依赖问题的预测本身就能较好地做到这一点。当评估模型自己答对时，交叉评估最有帮助；两个模型共享的错误通常仍保持高置信度。困难问题和共享错误仍是提示式自我复核与同伴监督难以处理的目标，即使模型本身具有很强的解题表现。

items.title: HeurEvo: Agentic Evolution of Hybrid Solver-Augmented Heuristics for Time-Critical Mathematical Optimization
items.abstract_or_text: Recent advances in agentic heuristic design use AI agents and execution feedback to automate algorithm discovery for challenging optimization problems. In many practical settings, high-quality solutions must be obtained under strict runtime constraints, motivating hybrid approaches that combine problem-specific heuristics with powerful mathematical programming solvers. However, existing approaches typically improve heuristic components within predefined procedures or tune solver configurations in isolation. This limits holistic adaptation of where to allocate computation, how to leverage solvers, and how to refine the overall algorithmic structure. To address these limitations, we propose HeurEvo, an automated plan--code--component co-evolution framework that jointly evolves the high-level algorithmic structures, their implementations, and a shared pool of reusable components. A planner determines which algorithmic components to use, how to combine them, and how to allocate runtime across stages, a coder realizes the resulting plan as executable code, while a component evolver updates the shared component pool. Within an island-based evolutionary framework, plans and implementations co-evolve with feedback from an interpreter agent that analyzes execution results and identifies opportunities for improvement. Across diverse combinatorial optimization benchmarks and challenging MIPLIB instances, HeurEvo finds high-quality solutions within tight runtime budgets, often matching or surpassing state-of-the-art optimization solvers given hours or days of computation. On several nonlinear geometry problems such as hexagon packing, it also improves upon the best previously reported results. These results highlight the value of jointly searching over algorithmic structure and implementation for agentic heuristic design.
items.summary_zh: HeurEvo 让规划器、代码器和组件池在岛模型进化框架中共同演化，并依据执行反馈改进算法结构、实现和计算分配；在组合优化、MIPLIB 和六边形装箱等任务上报告结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把智能体的数学优化能力落到可执行算法和运行时间约束上，评测不只看答案，还涉及求解器质量、预算和具体优化实例。
items.abstract_zh: 近期的智能体启发式设计进展使用 AI 智能体和执行反馈，自动化发现用于困难优化问题的算法。在许多实际场景中，需要在严格运行时间约束下获得高质量解，这促使人们采用将问题特定启发式与强大数学规划求解器结合的混合方法。然而，现有方法通常只在预定义流程中改进启发式组件，或孤立地调节求解器配置。这限制了对计算资源分配位置、求解器使用方式以及整体算法结构的综合适应。为解决这些限制，我们提出 HeurEvo，一个自动化的计划—代码—组件共同进化框架，联合演化高层算法结构、其实现以及可复用组件的共享池。规划器决定使用哪些算法组件、如何组合它们以及如何在各阶段分配运行时间；代码器将所得计划实现为可执行代码；组件进化器更新共享组件池。在基于岛模型的进化框架中，计划和实现根据解释器智能体对执行结果的分析以及其识别出的改进机会共同进化。在多种组合优化基准和具有挑战性的 MIPLIB 实例上，HeurEvo 能在严格运行时间预算内找到高质量解；在给出数小时或数天计算时间的情况下，它常常达到或超过最先进优化求解器的结果。在若干非线性几何问题（如六边形装箱）上，它还改进了此前报告的最佳结果。这些结果说明，在智能体启发式设计中联合搜索算法结构和实现具有价值。

items.title: An Integrated Analysis of Manganese Metabolism-Related Genes and Their Association With Biomarkers, Immune Infiltration, and Clinical Subtypes in Alzheimer's Disease.
items.abstract_or_text: Alzheimer's disease (AD), a neurodegenerative condition marked by amyloid-beta plaques and tau protein neurofibrillary tangles, progresses against a backdrop of essential biological processes. Manganese, an indispensable trace element for vital functions including energy metabolism and antioxidant defense, is integral to neurological health. Its precise metabolic role throughout the course of AD pathogenesis is not fully elucidated. Four essential manganese metabolism-related genes were identified as diagnostic markers through a multi-omic framework. This approach integrated Weighted Gene Co-Expression Network Analysis with machine learning ensembles (Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator/Random Forest/Extreme Gradient Boosting), followed by rigorous testing in an independent dataset. Beyond identification, we utilized CIBERSORT and ssGSEA to characterize immune infiltration and leveraged GSEA/GO/KEGG for pathway elucidation. Finally, AD patients were stratified into molecular subgroups based on these hub genes, and their underlying regulatory networks involving miRNAs and transcription factors were reconstructed. An integrated bioinformatics framework identified 12 differentially expressed genes related to manganese metabolism in AD. Machine-learning-based feature selection further pinpointed four key diagnostic biomarkers (TSPO, PTBP1, GLO1, and ACACB) with high discriminative power (AUC: 0.831-0.905). Immune infiltration analysis revealed substantial immune remodeling in AD, including an elevation of naïve B cells. Moreover, AD samples were classified into two molecular subtypes displaying distinct immune and metabolic characteristics, and regulatory miRNA/TF interaction networks were constructed for the core genes. Our results shed new light on the molecular mechanisms underlying AD and support future efforts toward early diagnosis and personalized therapeutic interventions based on molecular subtypes.
items.summary_zh: 这项同行评审研究在独立数据集测试后，将 TSPO、PTBP1、GLO1 和 ACACB 识别为 AD 的锰代谢相关诊断标志物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究有独立数据集测试并报告 AUC 0.831-0.905，但结果主要为组学与机器学习关联，尚不能证明锰代谢基因驱动 AD 或可直接指导治疗。
items.abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是一种以 amyloid-beta 斑块和 tau 蛋白神经原纤维缠结为标志的神经退行性疾病，其进展发生在关键生物过程的背景之中。锰是能量代谢和抗氧化防御等重要功能所必需的微量元素，对神经健康不可或缺。锰代谢在 AD 发病过程中所起的确切作用尚未完全阐明。通过多组学框架，我们将四个关键锰代谢相关基因识别为诊断标志物。该方法将加权基因共表达网络分析与机器学习集成方法（Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator/Random Forest/Extreme Gradient Boosting）整合，随后在独立数据集中进行严格测试。除标志物识别外，我们还采用 CIBERSORT 和 ssGSEA 表征免疫浸润，并利用 GSEA/GO/KEGG 阐释通路。最后，基于这些枢纽基因将 AD 患者分为分子亚组，并重建了涉及 miRNA 和转录因子的底层调控网络。整合生物信息学框架识别出 AD 中 12 个与锰代谢相关的差异表达基因。基于机器学习的特征选择进一步确定了 4 个具有高判别力的关键诊断生物标志物（TSPO、PTBP1、GLO1 和 ACACB；AUC：0.831-0.905）。免疫浸润分析显示 AD 存在显著免疫重塑，包括初始 B 细胞升高。此外，AD 样本被分为两个具有不同免疫和代谢特征的分子亚型，并为核心基因构建了调控 miRNA/TF 相互作用网络。我们的结果为 AD 的分子机制提供了新见解，并支持基于分子亚型推进早期诊断和个体化治疗干预的未来工作。

items.title: A scalable recombinant pipeline for disulphide-stapled peptides
items.abstract_or_text: Constrained macrocyclic peptides can engage protein surfaces that resist both small molecules and biologics but producing them at library scale still depends on chemical synthesis and macrocyclisation workflows that are slow, specialised and hard to parallelise. We describe a recombinant pipeline for disulphide-stapled cyclic peptides, compatible with 96 well plates, that lowers this barrier. Peptide-encoding sequences are introduced by extension PCR and in vivo assembly (IVA) cloning at about 2 per variant, expressed as small ubiquitin-like modifier (SUMO) fusions secreted to the oxidising periplasm, where the intramolecular disulphide forms spontaneously, and purified by immobilised metal-affinity chromatography (IMAC) with analytical size-exclusion chromatography (SEC). The route from a list of designs to characterised material takes about one week, much of it unattended. Applied to a 60-design library across nine protein targets, the pipeline gave purified products for all 60 designs, at a median total soluble yield of approximately 135 micrograms per 6 mL culture (range 9 to 261) that varied by target. Ellman's assay across 38 designs showed disulphide-formation failure to be sequence-driven and uncorrelated with yield, detecting a failure mode invisible to chromatography. Surface plasmon resonance confirmed target binding and showed that the recombinant SUMO fusion constructs retained affinities comparable to their corresponding peptide-only forms. Complementary to general-purpose recombinant platforms, the pipeline enables higher-throughput disulphide macrocycle screening and is amenable to partially or fully automated workflows.
items.summary_zh: 研究建立了适用于96孔板的重组表达流程，用于并行制备二硫键稳定的环肽，并在9个蛋白靶标的60个设计上验证产率、二硫键形成和结合活性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将受限大环肽的制备从慢速、难并行的化学合成推进到一周左右的半自动化流程，并用Ellman检测和表面等离子体共振揭示序列依赖的失败模式；不过产率随靶标变化，且摘要未覆盖更大规模或更多类型的环化化学。
items.abstract_zh: 受限大环肽可以结合同时抵抗小分子和生物制剂的蛋白表面，但在文库规模上制备它们仍依赖缓慢、专业化且难以并行的化学合成和大环化流程。我们描述了一种适用于96孔板的二硫键稳定环肽重组流程，从而降低这一门槛。肽编码序列通过延伸PCR和体内组装（IVA）克隆导入，以小泛素样修饰蛋白（SUMO）融合物形式表达，并分泌到氧化性周质中，在那里分子内二硫键自发形成；随后通过固定化金属亲和层析（IMAC）和分析型体积排阻色谱（SEC）进行纯化。从设计清单到获得表征材料的流程约需一周，其中大部分步骤无需人工值守。在覆盖9个蛋白靶标的60个设计文库上应用该流程后，60个设计均获得了纯化产物；每6 mL培养物的总可溶性产率中位数约为135微克，范围为9至261微克，并随靶标而变化。对38个设计进行Ellman检测表明，二硫键形成失败由序列驱动且与产率不相关，发现了色谱无法观察到的失败模式。表面等离子体共振证实了靶标结合，并显示重组SUMO融合构建体保持了与相应纯肽形式相当的亲和力。该流程可作为通用重组平台的补充，实现更高通量的二硫键大环筛选，并适用于部分或完全自动化的工作流。

items.title: Small-Molecule Data Splitting for Machine Learning in Drug Design
items.abstract_or_text: Data splitting is a critical determinant of machine-learning performance in small-molecule drug design. Different strategies impose distinct assumptions about structural similarity, temporal order, data provenance and chemical-space coverage, thereby affecting both evaluation realism and the interpretation of model performance. This perspective critically examines major splitting approaches, discusses their advantages, applicability and limitations, and offers evidence-based considerations for designing partitions aligned with intended prediction scenarios.
items.summary_zh: 该综述系统讨论小分子药物设计中随机、结构、时间、来源和化学空间划分策略对机器学习评估真实性及性能解释的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 指出数据划分会改变模型性能和结论含义，并给出与目标预测场景匹配的证据化建议；作为观点文章，它不提供新的模型或独立实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 数据划分是小分子药物设计中机器学习性能的关键决定因素。不同策略对结构相似性、时间顺序、数据来源和化学空间覆盖施加了不同假设，从而影响评估的真实性以及对模型性能的解释。本文综述批判性地考察主要划分方法，讨论其优点、适用性和局限，并为设计与预期预测场景相匹配的数据分区提出基于证据的考量。

items.title: Bridging the gap between omics and structural data: A framework for interpreting protein-RNA interaction specificity
items.abstract_or_text: Protein-RNA interactions play a central role in many cellular processes, such as gene regulation, protein synthesis and viral infections. Although a few thousand protein-RNA complexes have been structurally characterized, they represent only a small fraction of all interactions. This lack of experimental data limits the ability of deep-learning based approaches such as AlphaFold3 to predict structures of protein-RNA interactions. In this study, we investigate protein-RNA binding specificity by enriching experimental structures with omics data. To this end, we present a scoring approach and associated web resource quantifying the agreement between experimental structures of protein-RNA interfaces and their omics-derived binding preferences, allowing us to identify interaction motif cores. Through key structural and evolutionary features, we further highlight that these motif cores correspond to important interface regions. We then leverage the dataset of protein-RNA complexes for which structural information can be combined with binding preferences in order to benchmark the ability of AlphaFold3 to predict protein-RNA interaction specificity. To this aim, we run AlphaFold3 predictions using different RNA inputs, from the exact sequence present in the experimental structure to a non-specific sequence, including sequences embedding the consensus binding motif from in vitro experiments. We show that despite good prediction quality, the sensitivity of AlphaFold3 to the exact RNA sequence used as input indicates signs of memorization. We examine some particular complexes and uncover challenges encountered by our scoring workflow and AlphaFold3, especially in the case of alternative binding modes. Altogether, this work evidences both the promise and current limitations of deep learning approaches for protein-RNA structure prediction, and provides a resource to guide their further development.
items.summary_zh: 研究将实验蛋白质-RNA复合物结构与组学结合偏好整合，建立界面基序核心评分和网络资源，并测试AlphaFold3对RNA序列特异性的预测能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把有限结构数据与组学偏好结合起来，并揭示AlphaFold3对输入RNA精确序列的敏感性可能包含记忆化；替代结合模式仍会给评分流程和结构预测带来困难。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质-RNA相互作用在基因调控、蛋白质合成和病毒感染等许多细胞过程中发挥核心作用。尽管已有几千个蛋白质-RNA复合物得到结构表征，但它们只占全部相互作用的一小部分。实验数据的缺乏限制了AlphaFold3等基于深度学习的方法预测蛋白质-RNA相互作用结构的能力。在本研究中，我们通过用组学数据丰富实验结构，研究蛋白质-RNA结合特异性。为此，我们提出一种评分方法及其配套的网络资源，用于量化蛋白质-RNA界面的实验结构与组学推导的结合偏好之间的一致性，从而识别相互作用基序核心。通过关键的结构和进化特征，我们进一步指出这些基序核心对应重要的界面区域。随后，我们利用能够将结构信息与结合偏好结合起来的蛋白质-RNA复合物数据集，基准评估AlphaFold3预测蛋白质-RNA相互作用特异性的能力。具体而言，我们使用不同的RNA输入运行AlphaFold3预测，输入范围从实验结构中实际存在的精确序列到非特异序列，其中还包括嵌入体外实验共识结合基序的序列。我们显示，尽管预测质量良好，但AlphaFold3对所用精确RNA输入序列的敏感性表明存在记忆化迹象。我们考察了若干复合物，并发现该评分流程和AlphaFold3面临的挑战，尤其是在存在替代结合模式的情况下。总的来说，这项工作说明了深度学习方法在蛋白质-RNA结构预测中的前景和当前局限，并提供了可指导其进一步发展的资源。
