items.title: Advances in Multiscale Computational Modeling of 2D Nanomaterials for Solar Cells: From Interface Design to Fabrication and Stability
items.abstract_or_text: Two-dimensional (2D) nanomaterials provide a versatile platform for next-generation solar cells because their electronic structure, optical response, carrier transport, and interfacial chemistry can be engineered across multiple scales. However, photovoltaic performance and operational stability are governed not only by intrinsic material properties but also by coupled processes involving charge redistribution, interfacial recombination, ion migration, thermal transport, degradation, and fabrication-dependent microstructure. This review presents a closed-loop multiscale computational framework for the design, fabrication, and optimization of 2D-material-enabled solar cells. Density functional theory (DFT) and related quantum-mechanical methods are discussed for predicting band structure, band alignment, charge transfer, defect states, and optical properties, while molecular dynamics (MD) simulations address structural stability, ion migration, thermal effects, interfacial dynamics, and degradation. Finite element method (FEM)/COMSOL and device-scale models connect material-level descriptors to charge transport, recombination, thermal behavior, and photovoltaic metrics. Machine learning (ML) further enables high-throughput screening, property prediction, processing optimization, and inverse design. Particular emphasis is placed on bridging the simulation-to-fabrication gap by linking processing variables, including concentration, flake dimensions, functionalization, deposition, annealing, and interface formation, to realized structure and device performance. Experimental characterization and feedback are incorporated to refine computational models and guide subsequent design decisions. Overall, integrating quantum, atomistic, device-scale, data-driven, and fabrication-aware approaches provides a pathway toward efficient, stable, reproducible, and scalable 2D-material-based photovoltaic technologies.
items.summary_zh: 该综述提出面向二维纳米材料太阳能电池的闭环多尺度计算框架，将DFT、MD、FEM/COMSOL、机器学习、制备变量和实验反馈连接起来。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 强调从模拟到制备和器件稳定性的跨尺度闭环，适合指导高通量筛选、逆向设计及工艺优化；但文章为综述，具体模型性能和可重复实验结果取决于所引用研究。
items.abstract_zh: 二维（2D）纳米材料为下一代太阳能电池提供了多功能平台，因为其电子结构、光学响应、载流子输运和界面化学可以在多个尺度上进行工程化调控。然而，光伏性能和运行稳定性不仅由材料的内在性质决定，还受到电荷再分布、界面复合、离子迁移、热输运、降解以及制备相关微结构等耦合过程的影响。本综述提出一个用于2D材料太阳能电池设计、制备和优化的闭环多尺度计算框架。文中讨论了密度泛函理论（DFT）及相关量子力学方法，用于预测能带结构、能带对齐、电荷转移、缺陷态和光学性质；同时，分子动力学（MD）模拟用于研究结构稳定性、离子迁移、热效应、界面动力学和降解。有限元法（FEM）/COMSOL及器件尺度模型将材料尺度描述符与电荷输运、复合、热行为和光伏指标联系起来。机器学习（ML）进一步支持高通量筛选、性质预测、加工优化和逆向设计。文章特别强调弥合模拟与制备之间的差距，即将浓度、片层尺寸、功能化、沉积、退火和界面形成等工艺变量与实际形成的结构和器件性能联系起来。文中纳入实验表征和反馈，用于改进计算模型并指导后续设计决策。总体而言，整合量子尺度、原子尺度、器件尺度、数据驱动以及面向制备的多种方法，为实现高效、稳定、可重复且可规模化的二维材料光伏技术提供了一条路径。
items.author_line: Iman Najafipour, Santanu Chaudhuri

items.title: Foundation Neural-Network Quantum States for Molecular Potential Energy Surfaces in Second Quantization
items.abstract_or_text: Second-quantized neural-network quantum states have achieved accurate molecular energies, but extending them across molecular geometries requires a shared representation of the geometry-dependent wavefunction coefficients. We introduce geometry-conditioned foundation neural-network quantum states for molecular electronic structure in second quantization. A single autoregressive model learns a family of ground states from sparse anchor geometries and provides wavefunctions at untrained geometries without further optimization. Orbital alignment matches orbital identities and transports their phases, establishing an aligned orbital basis across geometries. Frozen energies reach chemical accuracy at every untrained query geometry for N_2, CO, and H_4. On additional molecular paths, the energy-trained wavefunctions yield dipoles, quadrupoles, and natural occupations without property labels. Across three paired N_2 training seeds, orbital alignment lowers the mean absolute energy error over all untrained query geometries from 34-37 mHa to 0.049-0.085 mHa. At approximately 1 mHa mean absolute error, frozen evaluation reduces the per-geometry cost by 986\times relative to independent optimization, yielding an estimated 25.8\times end-to-end GPU-cost reduction on a 161-point N_2 grid.
items.summary_zh: 研究提出几何条件化的二次量子化神经网络量子态，用单个自回归模型从稀疏锚点几何学习一族基态，并在未训练几何上无需再优化地给出波函数和能量。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 轨道对齐使未训练几何上的能量误差降至0.049–0.085 mHa，并将冻结评估的单几何成本降低986倍；当前展示主要集中于N₂、CO和H₄等小体系。
items.abstract_zh: 二次量子化神经网络量子态已经能够准确计算分子能量，但要将其扩展到不同分子几何，需要对依赖几何的波函数系数建立共享表示。我们提出用于二次量子化分子电子结构的几何条件化基础神经网络量子态。单个自回归模型从稀疏的锚点几何中学习一族基态，并能够在未训练的几何上无需进一步优化地提供波函数。轨道对齐匹配轨道身份并传递其相位，从而在不同几何之间建立对齐的轨道基组。在N₂、CO和H₄上，冻结能量在每个未训练查询几何处都达到化学精度。在额外的分子路径上，经过能量训练的波函数无需性质标签便能给出偶极矩、四极矩和自然占据数。在三组配对的N₂训练随机种子中，轨道对齐将所有未训练查询几何上的平均绝对能量误差从34–37 mHa降至0.049–0.085 mHa。在约1 mHa平均绝对误差下，与独立优化相比，冻结评估将每个几何的成本降低986倍，并在161点N₂网格上估计实现端到端GPU成本降低25.8倍。

items.title: Combining interstrand crosslinking agents with histone deacetylase inhibitors against high grade IDH mutant gliomas
items.abstract_or_text: Mismatch repair (MMR) deficiency contributes to temozolomide (TMZ) resistance in a subset of isocitrate dehydrogenase 1/2 mutant (IDHmut) gliomas, creating a need for therapies that retain activity despite MMR loss. We evaluated the novel interstrand crosslinking agent KL-50, alone and in combination with the histone deacetylase inhibitor belinostat, in patient-derived IDHmut glioma models. MSH6 knockout or constitutive expression established four matched MMR-proficient and MMR-deficient culture models. Drug responses were assessed using live cell count and cytotoxicity assays, and KL-50 monotherapy was tested in intracranial BT142 orthotopic xenografts. LOEWE synergy analysis, RNA sequencing, and a genome-wide CRISPR knockout screen assessed combination activity and potential mechanisms. MMR deficiency increased TMZ GI values 2.2- to 30.4-fold, whereas KL-50 retained antiproliferative activity and showed enhanced cytotoxicity in selected MMR-deficient models. In TMZ-naive, MMR-proficient BT142 xenografts, KL-50 increased median survival from 107.5 to 194 days. Two of eight treated mice had no histologically detectable residual tumor after 220 days post-engraftment. KL-50 and belinostat exhibited synergistic cytotoxicity in BT142, 905, and TS603 IDHmut glioma cultures. Transcriptomic gene ontology analyses identified downregulation of DNA repair pathways following histone deacetylase inhibition, including terms for homologous recombination and double-strand break repair. The CRISPR screen identified depletion of PKMYT1-targeting gRNAs during KL-50 treatment, implicating this mitotic checkpoint kinase as a candidate determinant of drug sensitivity. PKMYT1 expression was also reduced by histone deacetylase inhibition. These findings support further preclinical development of KL-50, alone and in combination with belinostat, for IDHmut gliomas including tumors with MMR-associated TMZ resistance.
items.summary_zh: KL-50 与 belinostat 在患者来源 IDHmut 胶质瘤模型中显示协同细胞毒性，并在原位异种移植模型中延长生存。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本结合匹配的 MMR 状态培养模型、RNA 测序、CRISPR 筛选和小鼠原位移植，提供了较完整的临床前证据；仍需进一步临床前开发和临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 错配修复（MMR）缺陷会导致一部分异柠檬酸脱氢酶 1/2 突变型（IDHmut）胶质瘤对替莫唑胺（TMZ）耐药，因此需要在 MMR 缺失情况下仍保留活性的治疗方法。我们在患者来源的 IDHmut 胶质瘤模型中评估了新型链间交联剂 KL-50 的单药作用及其与组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制剂 belinostat 的联用。通过 MSH6 敲除或组成型表达建立了四个相匹配的 MMR 完整和 MMR 缺陷培养模型。采用活细胞计数和细胞毒性试验评估药物反应，并在颅内 BT142 原位异种移植模型中测试 KL-50 单药。采用 LOEWE 协同作用分析、RNA 测序和全基因组 CRISPR 敲除筛选评估联合活性及潜在机制。MMR 缺陷使 TMZ 的 GI 值升高 2.2 至 30.4 倍，而 KL-50 保留了抗增殖活性，并在选定的 MMR 缺陷模型中表现出增强的细胞毒性。在 TMZ 初治、MMR 完整的 BT142 异种移植瘤中，KL-50 将中位生存期从 107.5 天延长至 194 天。8 只接受治疗的小鼠中有 2 只在移植后 220 天未检出组织学可见的残余肿瘤。KL-50 与 belinostat 在 BT142、905 和 TS603 IDHmut 胶质瘤培养物中表现出协同细胞毒性。转录组基因本体分析发现，组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制后 DNA 修复通路下调，包括同源重组和双链断裂修复相关术语。CRISPR 筛选发现，KL-50 治疗期间靶向 PKMYT1 的 gRNA 耗竭，提示该有丝分裂检查点激酶可能是药物敏感性的候选决定因素。组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制同样降低了 PKMYT1 表达。这些发现支持进一步开展 KL-50 单药及其与 belinostat 联用的临床前开发，用于包括具有 MMR 相关 TMZ 耐药肿瘤在内的 IDHmut 胶质瘤。
items.author_line: Sears, T. K., Coe, L., Chaliparambil, R., Wang, W., Gomez, M., McCord, M., Li, A., Gueble, S., bindra, r., Horbinski, C.

items.title: ScProteoAgent enables natural-language-driven single-cell proteomics analysis and interpretation
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell proteomics requires computational choices to remain aligned with experimental design as research questions evolve. Here we present ScProteoAgent, which translates natural-language requests into domain-specific calculations and preserves research intent, analysis design, matrix-processing history and statistical outputs as reusable analytical state. Follow-up requests reuse applicable inputs and initiate new calculations when contrasts or experimental units change. We assembled a benchmark comprising 55 tasks and 33 reference conclusions from 11 published studies, combining progressive questions within studies with complementary biological and analytical settings. In a retrospective comparison of 88 archived outputs from eight systems, ScProteoAgent achieved the highest mean score of 93.67 under a common six-dimensional rule-based evaluation. A HeLa migration case connected phenotype composition with proteomic clusters, candidate differences and original-observation support. In liver zonation, a researcher-guided follow-up reused a saved matrix to test mouse-level spatial contrasts and compare full-matrix and observed-only results. Applications in brain development, sample preservation and hematopoiesis illustrated how interpretation depends on processing choices and experimental units. ScProteoAgent connects research questions with statistical results and their analytical context, enabling existing analyses to support more specific biological investigations.
items.summary_zh: ScProteoAgent 将自然语言请求映射至单细胞蛋白质组计算，并保留可复用的分析状态和统计上下文。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本基于 11 项已发表研究构建 55 个任务基准，并对八个系统的 88 份历史输出作回顾比较；其表现仍依赖规则评估与既有研究数据。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞蛋白质组学要求计算选择随着研究问题演变而始终与实验设计保持一致。这里我们提出 ScProteoAgent，它将自然语言请求转化为领域特异性计算，并将研究意图、分析设计、矩阵处理历史和统计输出保留为可复用的分析状态。后续请求会复用适用的输入，并在对比或实验单位变化时启动新的计算。我们构建了一个基准，包含来自 11 项已发表研究的 55 个任务和 33 条参考结论，将同一研究中逐步推进的问题与互补的生物学和分析情境相结合。在对来自八个系统的 88 份归档输出进行回顾性比较时，ScProteoAgent 在统一的六维规则评估下取得最高平均分 93.67。一个 HeLa 迁移案例将表型组成与蛋白质组簇、候选差异及原始观察支持联系起来。在肝脏分带研究中，研究者指导的后续分析复用了已保存的矩阵，以检验小鼠水平的空间对比，并比较全矩阵和仅观察结果。在脑发育、样本保存和造血中的应用说明，解释如何取决于处理选择和实验单位。ScProteoAgent 将研究问题与统计结果及其分析语境联系起来，使现有分析能够支持更具体的生物学研究。
items.author_line: Hu, R., Ding, K., Wang, W., Zhu, Z., Chen, P., Wang, S., Wang, Y.

items.title: Inducing Process Supervision from Outcome-Only Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Process reward models (PRMs) have become a key component for LLMs, as their step-level feedback supports both post-training and test-time reasoning. However, training strong PRMs remains costly: human step annotation is difficult to scale, while Monte Carlo estimation is computationally expensive and can drift from the intrinsic correctness of steps. To get effective PRMs at low cost, we introduce TIPS (Thinking-Induced Process Supervision), an outcome-only reinforcement learning (RL) framework for training generative PRMs. In TIPS, the model generates a chain-of-thought (CoT) followed by step-level labels and an outcome label. The reward depends solely on whether the predicted outcome matches the ground truth, and the resulting group-relative advantage is used to optimize the entire generated response. Intuitively, when checking intermediate steps helps determine the outcome, more accurate checks can lead to better outcome judgments and higher rewards. Outcome-only RL can therefore reinforce step-level verification without explicit process supervision. We validate the effectiveness of TIPS across math and agent benchmarks and four backbone families. Notably, TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 reaches 85.2 F1 on ProcessBench with only 3.2K outcome-labeled trajectories, surpassing all evaluated trained PRMs and strong prompt-only judges such as GPT-5.4-Instruct and Claude-4.7-Opus, while still trailing o1-mini. Code and data are available at https://github.com/RUCBM/TIPS.
items.summary_zh: TIPS 仅使用最终答案是否正确的强化学习信号，训练生成式过程奖励模型同时输出思维链、逐步标签和结果标签；在 ProcessBench 上以 3.2K 条结果标注轨迹取得 85.2 F1。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作检验了能否从低成本的结果监督中诱导出步骤级验证能力，并在数学与智能体基准、四类骨干模型上给出对比结果。
items.abstract_zh: 过程奖励模型（PRM）已成为大型语言模型的重要组成部分，因为其步骤级反馈支持后训练和测试时推理。然而，训练强大的 PRM 成本高昂：人工步骤标注难以扩展，蒙特卡洛估计计算开销大，而且可能偏离步骤的内在正确性。为了低成本地获得有效 PRM，我们提出 TIPS（Thinking-Induced Process Supervision），一种用于训练生成式 PRM 的仅结果强化学习框架。在 TIPS 中，模型生成一条思维链，随后生成步骤级标签和结果标签。奖励只取决于预测结果是否匹配真实答案，并使用由此得到的组相对优势来优化完整生成响应。直观地说，当检查中间步骤有助于判断结果时，更准确的检查会带来更好的结果判断和更高奖励。因此，仅结果强化学习可以在没有显式过程监督的情况下强化步骤级验证。我们在数学和智能体基准以及四个骨干模型家族上验证了 TIPS 的有效性。值得注意的是，使用仅 3.2K 条结果标注轨迹的 TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 在 ProcessBench 上达到 85.2 F1，超过所有被评估的训练式 PRM 和 GPT-5.4-Instruct、Claude-4.7-Opus 等强大的仅提示评判器，但仍低于 o1-mini。代码和数据已发布于 https://github.com/RUCBM/TIPS。
items.author_line: Shengda Fan, Xin Cong, Zhong Zhang, Haotian Chen, Yankai Lin

items.title: Diagnosing and Improving Probabilistic Reasoning in Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as decision assistants who must reason probabilistically from available evidence under explicit decision costs. We propose a decision-theoretic framework that decomposes LLMs' decision loss into two components: forming accurate beliefs from provided evidence and translating those beliefs into actions that optimize a provided utility function. Using a synthetic benchmark with known ground truth, we apply the decomposition to characterize probabilistic reasoning in frontier and open-sourced models. We further evaluate whether RL interventions targeting beliefs, decisions, or both improve these components across three domains, whether improvements transfer across components and elicitation formats, and whether decision performance can improve without improvement in belief formation. We find that targeting one component of probabilistic reasoning redistributes decision loss, improving the target without necessarily transferring to others, and that jointly targeting belief formation and decision-making improves both but hinges on matched formats between training and evaluation.
items.summary_zh: 工作以具有已知真值的合成基准分解 LLM 概率推理损失，区分证据到信念的形成与信念到行动的决策，并测试分别或联合进行 RL 干预的迁移性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这种分解能检验模型是不会形成正确信念，还是不能把信念转成效用最优行动，避免只用最终决策分数推断推理能力。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被提议作为决策辅助系统，需要根据可用证据在明确决策成本下进行概率推理。我们提出一个决策理论框架，将 LLM 的决策损失分解为两个部分：根据所提供证据形成准确信念，以及将这些信念转化为能够优化给定效用函数的行动。我们使用具有已知真实值的合成基准，对前沿模型和开源模型中的概率推理进行刻画。我们进一步评估在三个领域中，针对信念、决策或两者的 RL 干预是否能改善这两个部分，改进是否能跨部分和跨诱导格式迁移，以及决策性能能否在信念形成没有改善的情况下提升。我们发现，针对其中一个部分会重新分配决策损失：目标部分得到改善，但不一定迁移到另一部分；同时针对信念形成和决策进行训练可以同时改善两者，但其效果取决于训练和评估格式是否匹配。
items.author_line: Huaman Sun, Dingcheng Wang, Jason Hartline, Jessica Hullman

items.title: RESCUE: Repairing Language Model Errors to Sparse Circuits via Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general capabilities that mechanistic interpretability has attributed to sparse computational circuits. However, existing circuit studies emphasize preserving functionality or explaining safety, leaving the mechanisms underlying failures across a broader range of tasks largely unexplored. Extending circuit analysis from abilities to errors, we explore the perspective that such failures may likewise arise from erroneous internal computations and that targeted tuning of the corresponding parameters can correct such errors while largely preserving other capabilities. Motivated by this insight, we introduce RESCUE (Reasoning-Error Sparse-Circuit Uncovering and Editing), a framework that localizes error-associated circuits and surgically repairs them for performance enhancement. General tasks typically involve multi-step reasoning and long-form generation, where early deviations can cause prefixes to drift from supervised references, leading SFT-based mask optimization to overlook circuits involved in generation-time errors. RESCUE therefore refines these masks through reinforcement learning with multiple masked-model rollouts, improving their relevance to observed task failures. Finally, RESCUE introduces a pruning technique and precisely fine-tunes error circuits to correct task failures, thereby translating error localization into a sparse and targeted model update. We validate RESCUE on heterogeneous repair sets across two domains: (1) mathematical reasoning, identifying a math error circuit of 1.40% density whose repair raises accuracy from 6.0% to 75.5%; and (2) medical QA, where a similarly compact 1.44% circuit improves repair-set accuracy from 0% to 81%. Our code is available at: https://github.com/chuanpupig/RESCUE.
items.summary_zh: RESCUE 用强化学习定位与推理错误相关的稀疏电路，再进行有针对性的参数修复；摘要报告数学推理修复集准确率从 6.0% 提升到 75.5%，医疗问答从 0% 提升到 81%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把模型错误定位与局部修复连接起来，并给出电路密度、修复前后准确率等可检验指标，但结果仍限于摘要所述修复集。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）表现出很强的通用能力，机制可解释性研究已将其归因于稀疏计算电路。然而，现有电路研究主要强调保持功能或解释安全性，对于更广泛任务中失败的机制探索仍然有限。我们将电路分析从能力扩展到错误，提出这样一种观点：这些失败同样可能源于错误的内部计算；通过针对相关参数进行调优，可以在基本保持其他能力的同时纠正错误。基于这一思路，我们提出 RESCUE（Reasoning-Error Sparse-Circuit Uncovering and Editing），一种定位与错误相关电路并进行手术式修复以提升性能的框架。一般任务通常涉及多步推理和长文本生成，其中早期偏离会使前缀偏离监督参考，因此基于 SFT 的掩码优化可能忽略生成时错误所涉及的电路。RESCUE 因此通过多次掩码模型 rollout 的强化学习来细化这些掩码，使其更贴近实际观察到的任务失败。最后，RESCUE 引入剪枝技术，并对错误电路进行精确微调，以修复任务失败，从而把错误定位转化为稀疏且有针对性的模型更新。我们在两个领域的异质修复集上验证 RESCUE：（1）数学推理，识别出密度为 1.40% 的数学错误电路，其修复将准确率从 6.0% 提高到 75.5%；（2）医疗问答，其中密度为 1.44% 的类似电路将修复集准确率从 0% 提高到 81%。代码已发布于：https://github.com/chuanpupig/RESCUE。
items.author_line: Chuanpu Liu, Miao Yu, Yikai Cai, Yuanhe Zhang, Zhenhong Zhou, Li Sun, Zuming Jiang, Yufei Guo

items.title: MetaCtrl: Your Large Language Models Can Reason Better and More Concisely with a Metacognitive Controller
items.abstract_or_text: Large reasoning models improve performance on challenging problems by allocating additional computation before answering, but longer reasoning does not always lead to better results and can introduce substantial redundant reasoning on simple problems. Conversely, aggressively shortening reasoning can degrade performance on difficult ones. Effective reasoning therefore requires dynamically deciding when additional computation is useful based on the reasoner's capabilities and evolving solution state. Existing approaches often rely on predefined budgets or intervention rules, retrain the target reasoner, or require additional supervision. We introduce MetaCtrl, a lightweight controller that adaptively regulates a frozen reasoner without predefined token budgets or reasoner retraining. We formulate reasoning regulation as a sequential metacognitive control problem: MetaCtrl observes the evolving reasoning trace and decides whether to continue, simplify, skip redundant steps, or conclude reasoning. It is trained directly with reinforcement learning using a reward that prioritizes correctness while favoring shorter trajectories among correct solutions, requiring neither supervised intervention trajectories nor problem-specific budgets. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and code, MetaCtrl consistently improves the accuracy of LRMs while reducing their reasoning length. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, it improves average accuracy by 4.7 points while reducing generation length by 53.3%. Without further training, the same controller transfers to an unseen reasoner (e.g., Qwen3-14B), improving average accuracy by 2.9 points and reducing generation length by 50.3%. These results establish MetaCtrl as a plug-and-play controller for improving reasoning accuracy while substantially reducing inference-time generation. The code is available at https://github.com/binbin2xs/MetaCtrl.
items.summary_zh: MetaCtrl 是不重新训练推理器的轻量控制器，将继续、简化、跳过冗余步骤或结束推理建模为序贯元认知控制；在七个数学、科学和代码基准上提高准确率并减少推理长度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它同时报告正确率、推理长度和跨推理器迁移，能检验“更长思维链”是否真的带来更好结果，而不是只追求更多 token。
items.abstract_zh: 强大的推理模型通过在回答前分配额外计算来提升困难问题上的性能，但更长的推理并不总是更好，而且可能在简单问题上引入大量冗余推理。相反，过度缩短推理可能会降低困难问题上的性能。因此，有效推理需要根据额外计算是否有用以及解答状态如何变化来动态决定是否继续计算。现有方法通常依赖预定义预算或干预规则，需要重新训练目标推理器，或需要额外监督。我们提出 MetaCtrl，一个无需预定义 token 预算或重新训练推理器、即可自适应调节冻结推理器的轻量控制器。我们将推理调节形式化为序贯元认知控制问题：MetaCtrl 观察不断生成的推理轨迹，并决定继续、简化、跳过冗余步骤或结束推理。它直接通过强化学习训练，奖励在优先保证正确性的同时偏好更短的正确轨迹，不需要监督式干预轨迹或特定问题预算。在覆盖数学、科学和代码的七个基准上，MetaCtrl 持续提高 LLM 推理器的准确率，同时减少推理长度。在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 上，它将平均准确率提高 4.7 个百分点，并将生成长度减少 53.3%。无需进一步训练，同一控制器还能迁移到未见过的推理器（例如 Qwen3-14B），将平均准确率提高 2.9 个百分点，并将生成长度减少 50.3%。这些结果表明，MetaCtrl 是一种即插即用的控制器，能够提高推理准确率并大幅减少推理时生成。代码：https://github.com/binbin2xs/MetaCtrl。
items.author_line: Zhibin Wen, Tao Han, Lei Bai, Can Li, Yang Xu

items.title: TMCS: Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving
items.abstract_or_text: Despite the promise of Large Language Models (LLMs) in computational chemistry, rigorous combinatorial chemistry problems remain difficult because they require quantitatively constrained molecular modification, candidate validation, and systematic revision after failed attempts. Existing tool-augmented chemical agents demonstrate useful planning and tool use, but they rarely provide a unified loop for property-driven molecular optimization and workflow-level composition. To bridge this gap, we propose Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving (TMCS), a step-by-step multi-agent framework that formalizes chemical problem solving as an interpretable, tool-augmented workflow. At the task level, specialized agents leverage external tools, few-shot trajectory memory, and structured reflection to iteratively refine solutions. At the workflow level, TMCS chains generation, understanding, editing, description, and optimization into a closed-loop pipeline. Evaluations across multiple chemical tasks demonstrate that TMCS consistently enhances chemical reasoning across both open- and closed-source base models, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
items.summary_zh: TMCS将组合化学问题形式化为由专门化代理、外部工具、少样本轨迹记忆和结构化反思组成的闭环工作流，连接分子生成、理解、编辑、描述和优化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对需要定量约束、候选验证和失败后修订的化学任务提供统一框架，并在多个任务和开源、闭源基础模型上报告一致提升；但摘要未给出任务规模、基线细节或实验化学验证。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在计算化学中前景广阔，但严格的组合化学问题仍然困难，因为它们需要定量约束下的分子修改、候选验证，以及失败尝试后的系统性修订。现有的工具增强型化学代理展现了有用的规划和工具使用能力，但很少提供面向性质的分子优化与工作流级组合的统一循环。为弥合这一差距，我们提出用于组合化学问题求解的工具扎根多代理推理（Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving，TMCS），一种将化学问题求解形式化为可解释、工具增强型工作流的分步多代理框架。在任务层面，专门化代理利用外部工具、少样本轨迹记忆和结构化反思，迭代改进解答。在工作流层面，TMCS将生成、理解、编辑、描述和优化串联成闭环流程。在多个化学任务上的评估表明，TMCS在开源和闭源基础模型上都能持续增强化学推理，并取得最先进性能。
items.author_line: Shengqin Wang, Jie Jin, Yu Cheng, Yihang Chen, Weilin Luo, Yuan Xie, Zhizhong Zhang

items.title: Mirror-Score: Calibrated, Inference-only Scoring Exposes the Limits of Sequence-compatibility Ranking in D-peptide Design
items.abstract_or_text: D-peptides combine protease resistance with high target specificity, but computational design of D-peptide binders remains immature. Mirror-Peptidizer introduced an in silico mirror-image screening pipeline using target reflection, backbone generation, and ProteinMPNN sequence design, but its raw ProteinMPNN negative log-likelihood (NLL) ranking was not validated against measured affinities, and only 4 of 9 tested MDM2 designs bound detectably. We introduce Mirror-Score, a calibrated, inference-only scoring framework for heterochiral D-peptide/L-protein complexes, and a public benchmark of 31 crystal complexes across four target families, including 18 with literature-verified affinities. Raw ProteinMPNN NLL is not a valid affinity ranker: its pooled Spearman correlation with affinity is 0.19, and correlations reverse between MDM2/CHIP (+0.62) and gp41 (-0.70). We therefore evaluate Boltz-2 mirror-space cofolding confidence. For the complete viral-entry family (7 structures representing 3 peptides), interface predicted local distance difference test (pLDDT) achieves structure-level leave-one-out Spearman rho = 0.90 (p = 0.006) and correctly orders all three peptides by affinity, whereas NLL fails (structure-level rho = 0.18). Because only three independent chemotypes are represented, this result indicates directional consistency rather than a statistically validated predictor. Cross-family calibration does not transfer at current sample sizes, supporting family-matched calibration as the practical deployment mode. We also specify a prospective design protocol for the antimicrobial-resistance targets LasR and LecB from Pseudomonas aeruginosa, including mirrored structures, ligand-derived hotspot maps, diffusion-model-ready inputs, and Mirror-Score ranking. Code, benchmark data, structures, and analysis scripts are openly available at https://github.com/Jiadalee/Mirror-Score.
items.summary_zh: Mirror-Score为异手性D-肽/L-蛋白复合物提出校准的仅推理评分，并用31个晶体复合物和文献亲和力检验ProteinMPNN及Boltz-2评分在D-肽设计中的排序能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 明确显示原始ProteinMPNN负对数似然并非可靠亲和力排序指标，并提出按靶标家族校准的替代方案；但病毒进入家族仅含3种独立化学型，结果仍是方向性证据而非统计学验证的预测器。
items.abstract_zh: D-肽兼具蛋白酶抗性和高靶标特异性，但D-肽结合剂的计算设计仍不成熟。Mirror-Peptidizer提出了一个计算机内镜像筛选流程，使用靶标反射、骨架生成和ProteinMPNN序列设计，但其原始ProteinMPNN负对数似然（NLL）排序尚未根据实测亲和力进行验证，并且测试的9个MDM2设计中只有4个表现出可检测的结合。我们提出Mirror-Score，一种针对异手性D-肽/L-蛋白复合物的校准型、仅推理评分框架，并建立了一个公开基准，包含来自四个靶标家族的31个晶体复合物，其中18个具有文献验证的亲和力。原始ProteinMPNN NLL不是有效的亲和力排序指标：其合并后的Spearman亲和力相关系数为0.19，而且在MDM2/CHIP（+0.62）和gp41（−0.70）之间相关性发生反转。因此，我们评估了Boltz-2镜像空间协同折叠置信度。对于完整的病毒进入家族（7个结构，代表3条肽），界面预测局部距离差异检验（pLDDT）在结构层面的留一法Spearman rho = 0.90（p = 0.006），并正确地按亲和力排序了3条肽，而NLL失败了（结构层面rho = 0.18）。由于其中仅代表3种独立化学型，这一结果说明了方向一致性，而不是经过统计学验证的预测器。当前样本量下，跨家族校准无法迁移，支持将家族匹配校准作为实际部署模式。我们还为来自铜绿假单胞菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）的耐药性靶标LasR和LecB规定了一个前瞻性设计方案，包括镜像结构、配体衍生的热点图、适用于扩散模型的输入以及Mirror-Score排序。代码、基准数据、结构和分析脚本均已公开发布，网址为https://github.com/Jiadalee/Mirror-Score。
items.author_line: Jiada Li

items.title: From Surfaces to Volumes: Registered Geometry for Protein Representation Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Existing protein geometry models typically represent molecular surfaces using local geometric features such as sampled points, normals, and curvature. While effective for capturing exposed molecular shape, these representations do not explicitly model the volumetric organization beneath the surface or provide a consistent coordinate system for residue-wise volumetric structure. We introduce Protein-TetSphere, a registered residue-wise volumetric representation for proteins. Each protein chain is tetrahedralized to obtain local volumetric regions associated with individual residues, which are then registered to a shared fixed-topology tetrahedral reference and represented in a common Laplacian basis. This registration establishes consistent volumetric coordinates across residues, enabling local three-dimensional deformation to be integrated with surface and chemical information in a multimodal protein representation. We evaluate Protein-TetSphere on ligand-binding pocket classification, protein--protein interface prediction, and de novo protein binder design. Across the three tasks, Protein-TetSphere improves ligand-binding pocket balanced accuracy from 0.795 to 0.826, Pinder-Pair/Site AUROC from 0.914/0.852 to 0.932/0.866, and binder-design success from 14.95\% to 19.90\% on the BoltzGen Challenge Set and from 27.62\% to 32.19\% at the ProtDBench backbone level. These results show that registered volumetric geometry provides complementary spatial information beyond molecular surfaces across protein recognition, interaction, and design.
items.summary_zh: Protein-TetSphere将蛋白质链四面体化，并注册到固定拓扑参考和共同拉普拉斯基底，建立残基级体积几何表示，用于结合口袋分类、蛋白界面预测和从头结合蛋白设计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 补充传统分子表面表示缺失的内部体积和统一坐标信息，在三个任务上均有定量提升；但摘要未说明改进是否跨数据集和蛋白家族稳定保持。
items.abstract_zh: 现有蛋白质几何模型通常使用采样点、法向量和曲率等局部几何特征来表示分子表面。虽然这些表示能够有效捕捉暴露的分子形状，但它们没有显式建模表面下方的体积组织，也没有为逐残基体积结构提供一致的坐标系。我们提出Protein-TetSphere，一种注册的逐残基蛋白质体积表示。我们对每条蛋白质链进行四面体化，以获得与各个残基相关联的局部体积区域；随后将这些区域注册到共享的固定拓扑四面体参考，并在共同的拉普拉斯基底中表示。该注册建立了一致的体积坐标，使局部三维形变能够与表面和化学信息整合到多模态蛋白质表示中。我们在配体结合口袋分类、蛋白质-蛋白质界面预测和从头蛋白质结合剂设计三个任务上评估Protein-TetSphere。在这三个任务中，Protein-TetSphere将配体结合口袋平衡准确率从0.795提高到0.826，将Pinder-Pair/Site AUROC从0.914/0.852提高到0.932/0.866，并将结合剂设计成功率在BoltzGen Challenge Set上从14.95%提高到19.90%，在ProtDBench骨架层面从27.62%提高到32.19%。这些结果表明，注册的体积几何能够在蛋白质识别、相互作用和设计中提供超越分子表面的互补空间信息。
items.author_line: Siyuan Chen, Cai Zhou, Jinrui Zhang, Zhaokang Liang, Taku Komura, Wojciech Matusik, Stephen Bates, Tommi Jaakkola, Wengong Jin, Peter Yichen Chen, Minghao Guo

items.title: Unified modeling of mutation-induced protein stability responses with OmegaTherm
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate prediction of mutation-induced protein stability responses, including changes in folding free energy and melting temperature, is critical for protein engineering. Existing models represent these related but non-equivalent measurements separately and often focus on single mutations. Here we present OmegaTherm, a sequence-based framework that jointly learns both stability responses for single and multiple mutations. OmegaTherm introduces a shared protein language model to capture transferable mutation context, measurement-specific encoders to preserve measurement identity, and paired-measurement-informed distillation to learn complementary knowledge from heterogeneous data. An antisymmetric prediction architecture further enforces physical consistency between forward and reverse mutations. Across independent benchmarks, OmegaTherm achieves state-of-the-art performance in quantitative prediction, mutation classification and protein-level ranking. Beyond benchmark prediction, OmegaTherm-derived stability landscapes correlate strongly with fitness landscapes from deep mutational scanning, enrich favorable variants and reveal function-associated mutation-sensitive regions. These results establish unified representation learning as an effective strategy for integrating related but non-equivalent biochemical measurements.
items.summary_zh: OmegaTherm以共享蛋白语言模型、测量特异编码器、配对测量蒸馏和反对称预测结构，联合预测单突变和多突变引起的折叠自由能与熔解温度变化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在独立基准、定量预测、突变分类和蛋白排序上报告最先进表现，并与深度突变扫描适应度景观相关；但摘要未给出各数据集规模和具体误差。
items.abstract_zh: 准确预测突变引起的蛋白质稳定性响应，包括折叠自由能和熔解温度的变化，对于蛋白质工程至关重要。现有模型通常分别表示这些相关但不等价的测量，并且往往聚焦于单突变。在此，我们提出OmegaTherm，一种基于序列的框架，联合学习单突变和多突变的两类稳定性响应。OmegaTherm引入共享蛋白语言模型以捕捉可迁移的突变上下文，引入测量特异的编码器以保留测量身份，并利用配对测量信息蒸馏，从异质数据中学习互补知识。反对称预测结构进一步对正向和反向突变施加物理一致性约束。在独立基准上，OmegaTherm在定量预测、突变分类和蛋白质层面排序方面均取得最先进性能。除基准预测之外，OmegaTherm导出的稳定性景观与深度突变扫描得到的适应度景观高度相关，能够富集有利变体，并揭示与功能相关的突变敏感区域。这些结果表明，统一表征学习是整合相关但不等价生化测量的一种有效策略。
items.author_line: Wang, W., Zhou, Y., Yu, W., Wu, Y., Yang, Q., Zheng, R., Huang, X., Li, M., Zhang, Y.

items.title: Recursive LLM Degradation in Biomedical Question Answering: A Cross-Generation Study
items.abstract_or_text: Repeatedly training language models on their own generated data may create a synthetic-data feedback loop in which errors and distributional biases are reintroduced into subsequent training datasets. This paper studies that process in biomedical question answering (QA) using PubMedQA and two Qwen2.5 model sizes, 0.5B and 3B parameters. The study compares a recursive synthetic-data condition, in which generation G(k+1) is trained on answers produced by G(k), against a Human-Control condition that repeatedly uses the original human training data. The study evaluates across four generations from G0-G3 with two random seeds (42 and 123) and a fixed evaluation set of 1,000 expert-labeled samples. The evaluation includes disease and chemical entity F1, context-supported rate, lexical and semantic similarity, answer length, repetition rate, and other evaluation metrics. The Recursive condition for both model sizes and both seeds showed larger declines than the Human-Control condition in disease entity F1, chemical entity F1, context-supported rate, ROUGE-L, and cosine similarity. Under the fixed no-repeat 3-gram decoding constraint, the main observed behavioral change was increased answer length, while the measured 3-gram repetition rate did not increase. The magnitude of the difference-in-change was larger for the 3B model than for the 0.5B model. This difference was particularly apparent in disease F1, context-supported rate, cosine similarity, and answer length. These results show domain-specific changes associated with using recursive synthetic-data training in biomedical QA, but do not establish clinical hallucination rates or universal model collapse.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在 PubMedQA 上发现，递归使用模型合成答案训练会降低生物医学 QA 的实体和上下文支持指标。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预印本使用两个 Qwen2.5 规模、两个随机种子、四代训练和固定专家标注评测集；作者明确表示结果不建立临床幻觉率或普遍模型崩塌。
items.abstract_zh: 反复在语言模型自身生成的数据上训练，可能形成一个合成数据反馈循环，其中错误和分布偏差会被重新引入后续训练数据集。本文使用 PubMedQA 和两种 Qwen2.5 模型规模——0.5B 和 3B 参数——研究这一过程在生物医学问答（QA）中的表现。研究比较了递归合成数据条件——第 G(k+1) 代在第 G(k) 代生成的答案上训练——与人类对照条件，后者反复使用原始人工训练数据。研究以两个随机种子（42 和 123）和包含 1,000 个专家标注样本的固定评估集，跨 G0-G3 四代进行评估。评估包括疾病和化学实体 F1、上下文支持率、词汇与语义相似性、答案长度、重复率和其他评估指标。对于两种模型规模和两个随机种子，递归条件在疾病实体 F1、化学实体 F1、上下文支持率、ROUGE-L 和余弦相似性方面均显示出比人类对照条件更大的下降。在固定的无重复 3-gram 解码约束下，观察到的主要行为变化是答案长度增加，而测得的 3-gram 重复率没有增加。3B 模型的变化差异幅度大于 0.5B 模型。这种差异在疾病 F1、上下文支持率、余弦相似性和答案长度上尤其明显。这些结果显示，在生物医学 QA 中使用递归合成数据训练与领域特异性变化相关，但并不确立临床幻觉率或普遍的模型崩塌。
items.author_line: Bibek Bhandari, Kshitij Lingthep

items.title: Inferring division-associated stochasticity from time-series single-cell transcriptomes
items.abstract_or_text: Cell division is fundamental to multicellular organisms, and stochastic partitioning of cellular components can strongly affect genome-wide gene expression. However, how cell division-associated stochasticity shapes cellular dynamics is poorly understood. Here, we propose scDIVIDE, a neural stochastic differential equation framework to jointly infer division rates and continuous cellular dynamics from time-series single-cell RNA sequencing data. We combined birth-death-mutation processes from population genetics with dynamical optimal transport and revealed that the birth (division) rate is embedded in the diffusion coefficient. scDIVIDE accurately inferred birth rates in synthetic data and the inferred birth rates recapitulated turnover-related programs in mouse hematopoiesis, mouse reprogramming, and human primordial germ cell-like cell induction data. By exploiting the birth-diffusion coupling, scDIVIDE provides a biologically informed constraint on growth rate estimation, outperforming existing methods in predicting future cell distributions. scDIVIDE offers a conceptual avenue for quantitatively dissecting how cell division shapes fate decisions in multicellular systems.
items.summary_zh: scDIVIDE 将群体遗传学出生—死亡—突变过程与动态最优传输结合，从时间序列 scRNA-seq 推断分裂率和连续状态动力学。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本在合成数据及小鼠造血、重编程和人类原始生殖细胞样细胞诱导数据中评估，为增长率估计加入生物学约束；其对命运决定的解释仍是模型推断。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞分裂对多细胞生物至关重要，而细胞组分的随机分配可强烈影响全基因组基因表达。然而，细胞分裂相关随机性如何塑造细胞动力学仍不甚清楚。这里，我们提出 scDIVIDE，这是一个神经随机微分方程框架，用于从时间序列单细胞 RNA 测序数据中联合推断分裂率和连续细胞动力学。我们将群体遗传学中的出生—死亡—突变过程与动态最优传输结合，揭示出生（分裂）率嵌入在扩散系数中。scDIVIDE 在合成数据中准确推断出生率，且所推断的出生率重现了小鼠造血、小鼠重编程和人类原始生殖细胞样细胞诱导数据中的周转相关程序。通过利用出生—扩散耦合，scDIVIDE 为生长率估计提供了具有生物学依据的约束，在预测未来细胞分布方面优于现有方法。scDIVIDE 为定量剖析细胞分裂如何塑造多细胞系统中的命运决定提供了一条概念路径。
items.author_line: Okochi, Y., Sawazaki, Y., Kondo, Y., Naoki, H.

items.title: Learning to Steer, Steering to See: Unveiling the Geometry of RLVR in Large Language Models via Trainable Vectors
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key paradigm for enhancing the reasoning of large language models, yet the high dimensionality of parameter updates makes its training dynamics hard to analyze. We study reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and use vector steering to identify a low-dimensional effective manifold in activation space associated with RL-induced gains. We uncover two geometric properties. (1) Effective Manifold Capacity: the capacity needed to reproduce RL gains can be very small but is not infinitely compressible; at extremely low capacity, intervention dimensionality and input-dependent expressiveness become key constraints, and this requirement varies with injection depth. (2) Control Manifold Separation: effective control directions lie mainly in the low-variance complement of the activation principal subspace. Within a task and base model, the learned geometry stays largely consistent across training configurations, and across tasks geometric alignment correlates with capability transfer. Experiments on 5 LLMs and 6 verifiable-reward tasks support these findings. We then propose Alpha-Stabler, a plug-and-play framework with a Predictor that monitors principal-subspace intrusion for early collapse warnings, and a Controller that removes the principal-subspace component of activation gradients during backpropagation while preserving the orthogonal complement. Alpha-Stabler stabilizes training for 2,000 steps and consistently improves RL gains, offering practical insights for robust post-training. Code: https://github.com/caiyuchen-ustc/On_Policy_Vector_Training
items.summary_zh: 该工作用可训练向量分析 RLVR 在 LLM 激活空间中的低维有效流形，提出 Alpha-Stabler 监测主子空间侵入并抑制相应梯度，以稳定后训练。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把强化学习推理增益转化为可观测的几何结构，并在 5 个 LLM、6 个可验证奖励任务上提供了跨配置的一致性与训练稳定性证据。
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习已成为增强大型语言模型推理能力的重要范式，但参数更新的高维性使其训练动态难以分析。我们研究带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），并使用向量引导在激活空间中识别与 RL 诱导增益相关的低维有效流形。我们发现了两个几何性质。（1）有效流形容量：复现 RL 增益所需的容量可能非常小，但并非可以无限压缩；在极低容量下，干预维度和输入相关的表达能力成为关键约束，而且这一需求会随注入深度变化。（2）控制流形分离：有效控制方向主要位于激活主成分子空间的低方差补空间中。在同一任务和基础模型内，学习到的几何结构在不同训练配置间大体一致；跨任务的几何对齐程度与能力迁移相关。我们在 5 个 LLM 和 6 个可验证奖励任务上的实验支持这些发现。随后我们提出 Alpha-Stabler，一个即插即用框架：其中 Predictor 监测主子空间侵入以提前预警坍缩，Controller 在反向传播时移除激活梯度的主子空间分量，同时保留正交补空间。Alpha-Stabler 可将训练稳定在 2,000 步，并持续改善 RL 增益，为稳健后训练提供实践见解。代码：https://github.com/caiyuchen-ustc/On_Policy_Vector_Training。
items.author_line: Yuchen Cai, Ding Cao, Qixiang Yin, Xin Xu, Kai Yang, Siye Wu, Pengyuan Wang, Jiaxuan Wang, Weijie Liu, Saiyong Yang, Guangzhong Sun, Guiquan Liu, Junfeng Fang

items.title: Reasoning with Continuous Latent Diffusion
items.abstract_or_text: Continuous diffusion generates complete reasoning solutions through iterative refinement in latent space. We introduce the Continuous Embedding Diffusion Reasoner (CEDR), an ELF-based training and inference recipe. Our experiments show that accurate decoding alone does not ensure strong reasoning performance. We therefore learn compact representations from multiple layers of a strong autoregressive teacher. Their decomposition also enables asynchronous denoising at different rates. We show that prompt encodings need only preserve the information required for the correct text-conditional score, rather than exactly match teacher features, and use a staged curriculum to learn a compact prompt encoder that replaces the teacher Transformer at inference. We adapt DiffusionNFT to learned self-conditioning guidance and incorporate gold-solution endpoints to supplement sparse rewards. Our supervised models outperform reported results from recent continuous-diffusion baselines at comparable backbone scales on mathematical reasoning and HumanEval code generation. With a 638M-parameter denoising backbone and learned prompt conditioning, post-NFT CEDR-L achieves 63.74% pass@1 on GSM8K and 24.6% on MATH500 at 64 denoising steps, and 32.85% on HumanEval and 30.18% on HumanEval+ at 128 denoising steps. Code will be available at: https://github.com/chengxiang/CEDR.
items.summary_zh: CEDR 研究连续潜变量扩散如何生成数学推理解答，结合教师表征、异步去噪、自条件引导和金标准终点；638M 去噪骨干在 GSM8K、MATH500 和 HumanEval 上报告了具体 pass@1。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它给出了连续扩散推理在数学题和代码生成上的可检验结果，同时提醒仅提高解码准确率并不自动带来更强推理。
items.abstract_zh: 连续扩散通过在潜空间中迭代细化来生成完整推理解答。我们提出 Continuous Embedding Diffusion Reasoner（CEDR），一种基于 ELF 的训练和推理方案。我们的实验表明，准确解码本身并不能保证强大的推理性能。因此，我们从强大的自回归教师模型的多层学习紧凑表示。对这些表示进行分解还支持以不同速率进行异步去噪。我们表明，提示编码只需保留正确文本条件得分所需的信息，而不必精确匹配教师特征，并使用分阶段课程学习训练紧凑提示编码器，使其在推理时替代教师 Transformer。我们将 DiffusionNFT 适配为学习式自条件引导，并加入金标准解答终点以补充稀疏奖励。在相当的骨干规模下，我们的监督模型优于近期连续扩散基线报告的结果，覆盖数学推理和 HumanEval 代码生成。采用学习式提示条件的 638M 参数去噪骨干，在 64 次去噪步数下，后 NFT 的 CEDR-L 在 GSM8K 上达到 63.74% pass@1，在 MATH500 上达到 24.6%；在 128 次去噪步数下，在 HumanEval 上达到 32.85%，在 HumanEval+ 上达到 30.18%。代码将发布于：https://github.com/chengxiang/CEDR。
items.author_line: Xiang Cheng

items.title: Pass or Fail? Evaluating LLMs on Two Greek Examination Benchmarks
items.abstract_or_text: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) imposes a thorough evaluation of their linguistic and analytical capabilities as well as constraints, particularly for a language with limited benchmark coverage such as Greek. To address the limited availability of comprehensive benchmarks in this domain, we introduce Prot-Ex and Pan-Ex, two benchmarks consisting of questions from entrance exams for Greek Model and Experimental schools as well as the Panhellenic exams (the Greek national university entrance examinations). These benchmarks are employed to assess the performance of text-only LLMs-including the Greek-adapted KriKri-8B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-4-26B, and Qwen-3-32B-across diverse academic disciplines (Modern Greek, Mathematics, Physics, etc.) and task formats (closed, structured, and open-ended), including textualized visual context (i.e., image descriptions). Our findings indicate the localized KriKri-8B significantly outperforms its base model, successfully rivalling much larger LLMs in linguistically demanding humanities tasks. By leveraging an LLM-as-a-Judge methodology, we expose the inadequacy of traditional lexical metrics for evaluating complex reasoning. Crucially, we uncover a few-shot prompting paradox: while synthetic examples improve accuracy in closed-ended questions, they severely overload the context window of 8B models in structured tasks, causing significant performance degradation. Ultimately, this study suggests targeted linguistic adaptation offsets lower parameter counts in specialized domains, despite the fragility of smaller models to prompt verbosity.

items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的快速发展要求全面评估其语言和分析能力及其局限，尤其是对于基准覆盖有限的语言（如希腊语）。为应对该领域综合基准不足的问题，我们提出 Prot-Ex 和 Pan-Ex 两个基准，题目来自希腊模范学校和实验学校的入学考试以及 Panhellenic 考试（希腊全国大学入学考试）。我们使用这些基准评估纯文本 LLM，包括适配希腊语的 KriKri-8B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-4-26B 和 Qwen-3-32B，覆盖现代希腊语、数学、物理等不同学科以及封闭式、结构化和开放式等题型，其中还包括文本化的视觉上下文（即图像描述）。研究结果表明，本地化的 KriKri-8B 在语言要求较高的人文学科任务上显著优于其基础模型，并成功匹敌规模大得多的 LLM。通过采用 LLM-as-a-Judge 方法，我们揭示传统词汇指标不足以评估复杂推理。我们还发现了一个少样本提示悖论：合成示例能提高封闭式问题的准确率，却会严重耗尽 8B 模型在结构化任务中的上下文窗口，导致性能显著下降。总体而言，这项研究表明，针对性语言适配可以抵消较小参数规模在专门领域中的劣势，但较小模型对提示冗余仍然脆弱。

items.title: Teach to Learn: Hint Annealing for Self-improving LLM Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves language-model reasoning by comparing verified rewards among multiple solution rollouts for each query. However, difficult training queries can yield only incorrect rollouts, leaving GRPO with no reward contrast or learning signal. Prior hint-based methods construct auxiliary hints from solution evidence and use them to re-solve failed queries, recovering learning signal. Yet the resulting trajectories are typically treated as ordinary solution trajectories despite being generated under an assisted condition unavailable at evaluation. We discover hinted reward shift: recovered reward contrast can concentrate policy updates on hinted trajectories, limiting improvement without hints. This also creates a trade-off: increasing hinted trajectories can accelerate early learning but intensify reward shift later. To address this problem, we propose HATCH (Hint-Annealed Self-Teaching), an online single-policy framework that learns from both generating and using its own hints to improve reasoning without assistance. To mitigate hinted reward shift, we introduce online weighting to anneal the contribution of hinted trajectories. However, learning to generate hints can conflict with improving query solving. We therefore use gradient projection to remove the opposing component of hint-generation updates. Together, these designs support self-improvement by enabling the policy to create learning opportunities for itself and turn them into stronger reasoning without hints. We evaluate our method on mathematical reasoning benchmarks and outperform state-of-the-art methods by 1.02 pp on Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, 2.84 pp on Qwen3-1.7B, and 4.32 pp on Qwen3-8B.
items.summary_zh: HATCH 针对 GRPO 在困难题上缺少奖励对比的问题，让策略在线生成并使用提示，同时通过权重退火和梯度投影减轻提示奖励偏移；在多个数学基准上取得增益。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它明确区分有提示训练轨迹与无提示评测条件，给出不同模型规模上的百分点提升，适合观察自我改进是否真正迁移到无辅助推理。
items.abstract_zh: 组相对策略优化（GRPO）通过比较每个查询的多次解答 rollout 中经过验证的奖励来改进语言模型推理。然而，困难训练查询可能只产生错误 rollout，导致没有奖励对比或学习信号。以往基于提示的方法从解答证据构造辅助提示，并用这些提示重新解决失败查询，从而恢复学习信号。但由此得到的轨迹通常被当作普通解答轨迹处理，尽管它们是在评估时不可获得的辅助条件下生成的。我们发现了提示奖励偏移：恢复的奖励对比可能把策略更新集中到带提示轨迹上，从而限制没有提示时的改进。这还形成了一种权衡：增加带提示轨迹可以加速早期学习，但会在后期加剧奖励偏移。为解决这一问题，我们提出 HATCH（Hint-Annealed Self-Teaching），一种在线单策略框架，使模型从生成和使用自身提示两方面学习，在没有外部辅助的情况下改进推理。为减轻提示奖励偏移，我们使用在线加权来退火带提示轨迹的贡献。然而，学习生成提示可能与改进问题求解发生冲突。因此，我们使用梯度投影移除提示生成更新中相互冲突的分量。综合这些设计后，策略能够通过为自身创造学习机会并将其转化为更强的无提示推理来实现自我改进。我们在数学推理基准上评估该方法，相比最先进方法，在 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct、Qwen3-1.7B 和 Qwen3-8B 上分别提高 1.02、2.84 和 4.32 个百分点。
items.author_line: Zile Wang, Zijian Li, Haodong Wang, Jian Liu, Qianli Liu, Lucas Muli, Blaze Chen, Song Guo

items.title: Improving Large Language Models for Code through Runtime Program-State Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models receive limited explicit training in reasoning about runtime program states. We study whether training models to reason about runtime program states improves downstream software-engineering capabilities. We introduce two complementary program-state reasoning tasks. Buggy input-output reasoning requires a model to generate a concrete input that exposes a behavioral difference between a buggy program and a hidden correct implementation and to predict the resulting execution behavior. Precondition-postcondition reasoning requires an agent to symbolically characterize a bug-triggering precondition, predict the expected postcondition, explain their causal connection, and instantiate this reasoning as an executable regression test. By incorporating these two tasks into a staged post-training pipeline, we develop Comet-9B, a 9B language model based on Qwen3.5-9B Base. We evaluate the resulting checkpoints on repository-level patch generation, regression-test generation, and security PoC generation. Adding both program-state reasoning tasks to supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on issue resolution improves success rates by 7.25 percentage points on SWE-bench Pro and 9.70 points on SWT-Bench Verified. Sequential reinforcement learning on the two tasks yields further gains of 7.25, 26.79, and 4.67 percentage points on SWE-bench Pro, SWT-Bench Verified, and CyberGym, respectively. Despite having only 9B parameters, Comet-9B achieves a score comparable to the reported GPT-5.2 result on SWE-bench Pro and matches the reported success rate of a GPT-4o-based agent on SWT-Bench Verified.
items.summary_zh: Comet-9B 增加运行时程序状态推理训练，包括构造触发 bug 的输入、预测执行行为、推导前置—后置条件并生成可执行回归测试；在 SWE-bench Pro、SWT-Bench Verified 和 CyberGym 上报告增益。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把程序状态、因果连接和可执行测试作为可检验推理任务，连接了形式化式验证思路与软件工程模型能力评测。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型在运行时程序状态推理方面接受的显式训练有限。我们研究，训练模型推理运行时程序状态是否能改善其下游软件工程能力。我们提出两个互补的程序状态推理任务。带缺陷的输入—输出推理要求模型生成一个具体输入，以暴露有缺陷程序与隐藏的正确实现之间的行为差异，并预测由此产生的执行行为。前置条件—后置条件推理要求智能体符号化刻画触发缺陷的前置条件、预测预期后置条件、解释二者的因果联系，并将该推理实例化为可执行回归测试。通过把这两个任务纳入分阶段后训练流程，我们开发了 Comet-9B，一个基于 Qwen3.5-9B Base 的 9B 语言模型。我们在仓库级补丁生成、回归测试生成和安全概念验证生成上评估训练所得检查点。在问题解决上，对两个程序状态推理任务进行监督微调（SFT）使 SWE-bench Pro 的成功率提高 7.25 个百分点，使 SWT-Bench Verified 提高 9.70 个百分点。在这两个任务上进行顺序强化学习后，SWE-bench Pro、SWT-Bench Verified 和 CyberGym 的成功率又分别提高 7.25、26.79 和 4.67 个百分点。尽管只有 9B 参数，Comet-9B 在 SWE-bench Pro 上取得了与报告中的 GPT-5.2 结果相当的分数，并在 SWT-Bench Verified 上达到了基于 GPT-4o 的智能体所报告的成功率。

items.abstract_or_text: Predicted structures for protein complexes from more than 2,800 viruses went into the AlphaFold Database last week, free for anyone to use. The team ran 41,774 viral proteins through AlphaFold2, optimized with @nvidia BioNeMo, and generated about 1.7 million predicted pairings. Roughly 8,000 passed the quality bar for the curated database.
